articleTitle: Indoor Navigation with Augmented Reality
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Technology (CSAT)
abstract: This paper introduces the idea of Indoor Navigation using Augmented Reality, we propose a QR code location position system using the augmented reality technique for indoor navigation. This system advice directions to the destination in the user's camera screen. QR codes will be installed at some locations in the building assuming any destination can be the starting point of the user. Users can scan a QR code to choose a destination. AR foundation takes live feed from the user's camera and does simultaneous localization and mapping to update the user's location. We use the A * algorithm to find the shortest path to the chosen destination and the directions to the destination are shown in user's camera screen by using some essential plugins like AR foundation. We point to developing the way between the start point location and end point in the simplest way possible so that the users can easily reach their destination by just opening the camera where the directions are shown as animations in their surroundings. We also can add some animate models so that we can see in real world, which help users feel more interactive and immersive.

articleTitle: Design of A New Multi-Channel Parallel Wideband Digital Radar Reconnaissance Receiver
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Technology (CSAT)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of high sampling rate of ADC required by modern radar reconnaissance receiver, a new signal acquisition system scheme is presented in this paper. In this system, multiple low-rate ADCs are sampled in parallel, and the spectrum of the signal is recovered by adaptive beamforming algorithm, so as to obtain the complete signal frequency domain information. In this paper, according to the actual working conditions and real-time requirements of radar reconnaissance receiver, the performance optimization and parameter calculation of the spectrum recovery algorithm are carried out, and the algorithm is simulated. The simulation results of the algorithm results of the radar signal processor show that this method can effectively improve the bandwidth of the reconnaissance receiver, and obtain better spectrum analysis results.

articleTitle: Design of Real Vehicle Communication Protocol and Vehicle Controller Software Architecture Based on EEPROM Function
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Technology (CSAT)
abstract: With the revolution of automotive electrification and intelligent technology, automotive chassis has also undergone a technological transformation from traditional chassis, electric chassis, to intelligent chassis. The intelligent chassis for autonomous vehicle provides a bearing platform for auto drive system, cockpit system and power system. The chassis will realize subsystem redundancy, distributed drive structure and highly integrated control of all systems. This article focuses on the design of intelligent wire controlled chassis systems, critical dynamic state estimation, trajectory tracking and stability collaborative control, actuator fault detection and fault-tolerant control issues. This article determines the architecture and overall design scheme of the distributed independent drive intelligent wire controlled chassis experimental platform based on the design objectives, establishes the CAN bus application layer communication protocol for the entire vehicle, and uses the CAN bus as the communication medium to connect the entire vehicle controller and the underlying execution components. This article determines the software architecture design of the vehicle controller for a distributed four wheel independent drive experimental platform vehicle. Using Matlab Simulink to establish a vehicle control model, mainly including the Rapid ECU Setting module and System_ Init module, EEPROM Enable module, and control model. The control model mainly includes the input, processing, and output of all sensors. This article establishes a CAN bus application layer communication protocol for the entire vehicle, using CAN bus as the communication medium to connect the vehicle controller and the underlying execution components. And during the software design process of the chassis domain controller, the key data collection and recording functions of the sensors were reserved.

articleTitle: Bypass Leakage Risk Assessment Based on Mutual Information Game
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Technology (CSAT)
abstract: Mutual information game theory is introduced in the decision-making process of the cryptographic chips designers (defense party) and the attacker, a risk quantification evaluation model based on mutual information game is built. It investigates the attack and designs tactics choice to security risks, and combining with the quantitative methods of the mutual information, gives the optimization tactics selection method of the bothsides of attack and designs on Nash equilibrium conditions, gives the mutual information benefits of the both sides of attack and designs on Nash equilibrium. Through the case analysis, the validity of the strategy is proved.

articleTitle: Improving Elevator Quality Detection and Emergency Work Based on TOPSIS Evaluation and SVM Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Technology (CSAT)
abstract: This article establishes a TOPSIS comprehensive evaluation model for elevator quality inspection and emergency work in Liaoning Province, China, and uses a machine learning SVM algorithm to predict the elevator operation rate of 14 cities in Liaoning Province. The study found that Anshan and Jinzhou are the two cities with the worst comprehensive evaluation, far lower than other cities. Therefore, to improve elevator quality inspection and emergency work, the Liaoning Special Equipment Inspection Center should start with a comprehensive rectification and improvement of elevator quality inspection and emergency work in Anshan and Jinzhou. The SVM algorithm can successfully predict the elevator operating rates of various cities in Liaoning Province with the prediction error being very small.

articleTitle: Structural Design and Key Technology Research of Simulator for Branch Airports Controller Training
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Technology (CSAT)
abstract: At present, the control operation mode of most branch airports in China is the integration of the tower and the approach, so the simulator training for the controllers needs to have the visual simulation function of the tower. The existing radar/non-radar simulator cannot meet this demand. The traditional tower simulator is difficult to put into practice due to the area and high cost, and the visual simulation of the existing tower simulator can not meet the needs of long-distance visual of “tower and approach integration”. In view of the above problems, a simple and efficient control simulator was designed and proposed as “The tower and approach controller integration training simulator” ( “tower and approach integration” in short in the message) which is easier to deploy and put in practice in branch airports. An aircraft target rendering algorithm based on distance segmentation is proposed to improve the long-range high imaging effect of aircraft in visual simulation and reduce the construction and use cost, if it put in practice, which can solve the problem that the type of controller license endorsement, the actual situation of work is inconsistent with the training content, so as to make it conform to the requirements of the current regulations.

Author Keywords: simulator tower and approach integration visual simulation long-distance holographic imgery low cost

articleTitle: Computational Analysis and Numerical Simulation of Baige Residual Landslides
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Technology (CSAT)
abstract: In 2018, two extremely large landslides occurred in Baige village, Jinsha River. Especially after the second landslide, strong deformation appears at the trailing and side edges of the landslide area, producing a series of potentially unstable blocks (a.k.a. residual bodies). The stability analysis of those blocks is performed at first by means of a strict 3D limit equilibrium method to provide overall risk assessments. Then, the SPH-DEM model is applied to simulate the entire disaster chain, in which the extent and the accumulation of the landslides are investigated in an intuitive manner. The results show: (1) KI-I and K2-I blocks are in a critical state, with a greater risk of instability and possibility of another landslide to block the river. (2) The disposal of river dredging can reduce the height of the barrier dam, increase the accumulation space for landslide, and effectively lower the resultant risk of river blockage. (3) This method is valuable and referable for risk prediction and evaluation of disaster chain caused by high-level landslide.

articleTitle: Design and Manufacture of Automatic Test-Bed for Locomotive Wiper
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Technology (CSAT)
abstract: the windshield wiper is installed on the front glass of the locomotive-driver's cell to sweep away the rain, snow and dust, which block the view. At present, there is no special test equipment for locomotive wiper in the market, and the relevant regulations of locomotive overhaul can not be implemented. Maintenance cost increased and time long are the limited factors which can not meet locomotive depot development. Maintenance requirements of the wiper must meet the rated work pressure detection, speed wiper frequency, high and low speed difference, intermittent time, wiper angle. The device automatically controls the wiper, collects the signal of the photoelectric switch, and switches the swing direction of the wiper automatically, which achieved the accurate measurement and calculation of rotation angle and rotation speed. the test results can be automatically determined and the maintenance records are automatically generated. It can effectively improve the efficiency of operations, reduce maintenance costs and ensure the quality of maintenance.

articleTitle: Application of Fault Analysis Model Based on Multimodal Data in Intelligent Operation and Maintenance of Island Photovoltaic
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Technology (CSAT)
abstract: With the increasing global energy demand and the severity of environmental issues, photo- voltaic power generation has received increasing attention as a clean and renewable energy source. However, the unique environment and complex nature of photovoltaic power plants have posed challenges for fault diagnosis and operational optimization. To address this issue, intelligent operation and maintenance technology for island photovoltaic systems has emerged. This technology utilizes artificial intelligence, the Internet of Things, and big data to achieve real-time monitoring, fault diagnosis, and operational optimization of photovoltaic power plants, thereby improving their efficiency and reliability. Among these technologies, artificial intelligence plays a central role. In this paper, we propose a fault analysis and pre- diction model based on multimodal data, which employs customized multimodal learning methods to enhance the accuracy of fault analysis in photovoltaic power plants.

articleTitle: An Improved Scheduling Algorithm Based on Jellyfish Search for Measurement Data Process System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Technology (CSAT)
abstract: Parallel computing of real-time data is an effective solution to the problem of timely analysis with the rapid increase of real-time data in today's power grid. Currently, most data parallel processing methods do not consider the characteristics of the real-time power measurement data to improve efficiency. This paper proposes an improved jellyfish search method for data process task scheduling, which considers time window segmentation based on data arrival characteristic. The method proposed in this paper can improve the processing speed of realtime power measurement data with resources reduction.

articleTitle: Design and Experimental Study of Seedling Tray Handling Device
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Technology (CSAT)
abstract: Producing seedlings in a plant factory possesses the qualities of easy administration, which can provide healthy seedling resources for agricultural production. Due to the height and structural limitations of the cultivation frame, manual handling of seedling trays not only requires more physical strength but also increases the risk of accidents. This study created an automatic seedling tray handling device to address this issue. It can adjust the length of the bottom guiding mechanism and the height of the lifting mechanism based on the height and quantity of stereoscopic culture bed frames. The designed vertical lifting mechanism and tray pushing mechanism can transport the seedling trays to each layer of the stereoscopic seedling bed frame. The static analysis of the seedling tray support plate was carried out using Ansys software. Experimental results showed that the maximum deformation is 0.68mm, which can meet the design requirements. Through the analysis of the height positioning deviation in the vertical direction and the positioning error of the propulsion mechanism, it is concluded that the height of the seedling tray to be lifted when it is propelled should be higher than the upper surface of the water tank by 5mm; under the setting of the primary propulsion speed of 250mm/s and the secondary propulsion speed of 60mm/s, the average success rate of seedling tray conveying is 96.7% The overall design can satisfy the requirements of the work of seedling tray conveying.

articleTitle: Design of the Grid WebGIS-Based Remote Power Grid Line-Tracking System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Technology (CSAT)
abstract: Aiming at the traditional remote power grid line monitoring and using manual screening methods, with the distribution of the line complexity increases, the tracking system efficiency is not high, a distributed geographic information system network (WebGIS)-based remote power grid line-tracking system optimization design method is proposed. Firstly, the overall design of the system is carried out. The WebGIS-based remote power grid line-tracking system is mainly composed of wireless sensor module, line fault processor module, line fault data communication module and energy supply module of the system. Secondly, the distributed localization algorithm of the Grid WebGIS-based remote power grid line-tracking system is designed. Finally, the clock circuit, transmit matching circuit, and system power supply hardware module of the system are designed. Simulation experiments of the system are carried out under Visual DSP + + 4.5, and the simulation results show that the system can effectively and accurately realize the remote power grid line-tracking and fault monitoring, and the fault nodes can be located with high accuracy, realizing intelligent line-tracking.

articleTitle: The Application of Network Topology Based on Autonomous Learning Characteristics in Virtual Power Plants
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Technology (CSAT)
abstract: With the emergence of global warming, shortage of fossil energy resources and other issues, the scale of distributed energy installations continues to expand and has become an indispensable and important component of the energy strategy. This article comprehensively considers safety and economic requirements, studies the adaptability and controllability of distributed energy, establishes a virtual power plant (VPP) network topology based on autonomous learning characteristics, and establishes related mathematical models and solution methods. This article takes a typical virtual power plant as an example to verify the application of virtual power plant network topology based on autonomous learning characteristics in virtual power plant research. In the 15th demand response, the total load was 34460MW, the regulated load was 54429MW, and the idle load was 54419MW. At this time, the regulated load and the idle load were very close. The research results of this article will provide a more credible parameter basis for power spot transactions, and are of great significance to the reform and development of the overall energy structure.

articleTitle: High-Level Synthesis Algorithm for Continuous-Flow Microfiuidic Biochips Under Device Volume Constraints
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Technology (CSAT)
abstract: Continuous-flow microfluidic biochips (CFMBs) can precisely manipulate microfluids for bioassays. In order to enhance the efficiency of bioassays, it is imperative to carefully consider operation scheduling and device binding schemes. The existing work has considered device volume constraints at high-level synthesis to meet the actual fluid transport requirements of the CFMBs. However, this work is based on integer linear programming, which has a high algorithmic complexity and makes it difficult to meet the large-scale integration requirements of CFMBs. Therefore, a fast high-level synthesis algorithm based on a discrete particle swarm algorithm under device volume constraint is proposed. We propose a particle encoding scheme based on the operation priorities and the device binding scheme. In addition, the corresponding particle initialization method and update strategy are proposed to satisfy the device volume constraint. The experimental results show that the proposed algorithm can obtain high-level synthesis results in a short time.

articleTitle: Research on Electromagnetic Shielding Methods Based on SAR Image Simulation
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Technology (CSAT)
abstract: With the increasing sophistication of radar systems, radar stealth technology has become increasingly important for battlefield targets. Due to some targets having fixed shapes and large volumes, it is difficult to completely cloak them using material stealth technology. It is necessary to study the distribution of strong scattering positions of the targets and apply stealth material coatings to these important positions to reduce the overall Radar Cross Section (RCS) of the targets, decrease the probability of radar detection, and enhance the survivability of the targets. This paper takes a certain type of aircraft target as an example, establishes a target model, and uses FEKO software to simulate the target's SAR images. By analyzing SAR simulation images at different angles, the distribution of the target's strong scattering positions is obtained. The paper also simulates and compares the changes in the overall radar scattering characteristics of the target before and after stealth treatment at these strong scattering positions.

articleTitle: Feasibility Study of Electrification in Construction Machinery Based on Energy Demand
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Technology (CSAT)
abstract: The electrification of mechanical equipment can effectively reduce the large amounts of nitrogen oxides and carbon dioxide emitted by construction machinery in cities. This article sets typical types of machinery used in urban operations as the analytical samples to represent the power. Load data during actual operations were collected through the On-Board Diagnostics (OBD) interface of the machinery, and the actual activity levels of the machinery were obtained through surveys. Based on the minimum energy requirements, the usage limitations of construction machinery were analyzed considering the current technological level and market supply conditions. The analysis results show that small-sized construction machinery has already met the sufficient conditions for electrification and can adopt lead-acid batteries for power propulsion during the electrification process. Medium-sized construction machinery presents higher difficulties for electrification and should use high-energy density batteries such as lithium-ion batteries for power. Large-sized construction machinery does not yet meet the conditions for widespread electrification.

articleTitle: HCTNet: Hybrid CNN-Transformer Architecture Network for Self-Supervised Monocular Depth Estimation
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Technology (CSAT)
abstract: Estimating depth from images is a crucial computer vision task with wide-ranging applications in fields such as autonomous driving, drones, and virtual reality. Self- supervised monocular depth estimation utilizes image sequences to achieve semi-supervised learning and has shown promising application prospects. However, current self-supervised methods still suffer from deficiencies in enhancing feature dependencies and properly handling local information, resulting in limited performance and low prediction accuracy. In this work, we propose a novel network architecture, HCTNet, based on the U- Net framework, aimed at further improving prediction accuracy. The network utilizes a Hybrid CNN- Transformer as the depth encoder to capture and convey contextual information, demonstrating competitive results on the KITTI dataset.

articleTitle: Research on Power Control Algorithm Based on Non Cooperative Game in D2D Communication
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Technology (CSAT)
abstract: The introduction of D2D improves the performance of communication systems but introduces interference management problems. The algorithm adopts a noncooperative game framework, introduces a dynamic cost mechanism, suppresses the common-channel interference within the system, analyses that the solution of the Nash equilibrium in the process of this game exists and is unique, and gives a distributed power adjustment algorithm for D2D users to engage in rational competition under the noncooperative game model. Theoretical analyses and emulation results show that the arithmetic greatly improves the throughput of the system while effectively controlling the interference between the communicating users within the system.

articleTitle: RCALN: A Hybrid Intrusion Detection System Incorporating Channel Attention in CNN and Residual Networks with LSTM
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Technology (CSAT)
abstract: In today's highly interconnected world, our reliance on networks has become indispensable. However, the widespread adoption of networks, while bringing convenience to our lives, has also exposed numerous security vulnerabilities. Certain network software harbors backdoors and vulnerabilities, which malicious entities exploit to infiltrate our systems, leading to potential exposure of sensitive information or even financial losses. In the current landscape of pervasive networking, ensuring network security and devising precise intrusion detection systems capable of identifying anomalous traffic are of paramount importance. Many research endeavors are leveraging deep learning techniques for intrusion detection. However, prevailing methods suffer from shallow network architectures and a lack of attention mechanisms, thereby impeding the detection performance. In this context, we propose the RCALN detection model, which integrates Channel Attention into Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and employs an alternating CNN-LSTM architecture to extract traffic features. Moreover, we incorporate residual networks to deepen the layers of the CNN-LSTM hybrid network. Our model demonstrates promising performance across three public intrusion detection datasets.

articleTitle: Research on Internet Enterprise User Data Control System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Technology (CSAT)
abstract: With the rapid development of mobile Internet, diversified online internet applications for our lives have brought tremendous changes, and the development of society has had a far-reaching impact. However, with the popularity of mobile Internet, users' information security is also facing increasingly severe challenges, in the non-secure internet environment, users' data privacy will not be effectively protected. If the attacker has the user's personal information, it may lead to property loss, identity theft, and even personal security and a series of serious consequences. The leakage of personal privacy will not only bring losses to users, but also bring great harm to social stability. At present, the security of user data mainly depends on the privacy policy of service providers, but only from the policy point of view, it can not effectively protect user data privacy. Broadly speaking, user data can be divided into two types, in which the leakage of privacy information refers to the real-name authentication on the Internet, by multiple service providers in possession of data credentials; Users keep shared data in the hands of external third parties, and users have no control over their data usage. As more and more netizens begin to pay attention to their privacy leakage, and more and more privacy protection awareness, people have higher and higher demands on their privacy protection.

articleTitle: Research on Search Engine Optimization Strategies Based on Google Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Technology (CSAT)
abstract: Google is the world's largest search engine. Every update of its algorithm has a huge impact on the Internet. The operation of enterprise websites needs to keep abreast of algorithm updates, and at the same time, formulate a search engine optimization strategy that meets the requirements of the updates, and continue to optimize the website, so that only by gaining more attention and traffic can we create value for the enterprise. This article analyzes the core update algorithms launched by Google in 2020-2023, and formulates reasonable optimization strategies and implementation methods. It also uses the code optimization case of the “How to apply for admission” page on the PCU website as an example to explain the optimization process, and provides reference for website operators.

articleTitle: Spammer Groups Detection Method Based on Local Expansion and Graph Contrastive Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Technology (CSAT)
abstract: The detection of spammer groups can help restrain the spamming behaviors, which is of great significance to ensure the credibility of review information on e-commerce platforms. However, the existing community detection-based methods for detecting spammer groups ignore the overlapping between spammer groups. Moreover, handcrafted indicators-based methods lack universality. Aiming at these problems, we propose a spammer groups detection approach based on local expansion and graph contrastive learning. First, we model the review dataset as a weighted user relationship graph by leveraging the user-product rating information and user-product-user meta- path information. Second, we design a local expansion-based overlapping community detection method to find candidate groups. Third, we apply graph contrastive learning to obtain the group vector representations and use local-global mutual information maximization to update model parameters. Finally, we utilize the isolation forest algorithm to calculate group suspiciousness and obtain spammer groups. The experimental results on Amazon and Yelp NYC datasets show that the proposed method has better detection performance than the baselines.

articleTitle: Design and Simulation of FIR Digital Filter Under FPGA
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Technology (CSAT)
abstract: Traditional filters often encounter issues such as introducing delay. As a common type of digital filter, FIR (Finite Impulse Response) filters have linear phase characteristics and stability, and digital filters have high importance in signal processing. FPGA (Field Programmable Gate Array) also has great advantages as an implementation platform. In order to implement FIR digital filters based on FPGA, this article adopted classic filter design methods. Firstly, the appropriate filter type was selected, and then the filter coefficients were calculated. Next, the FPGA development tool was used to implement the filter structure and simulation experiments were conducted. Through simulation experiments, the performance of the designed FIR digital filter was evaluated, and the amplitude and phase responses of the filter were analyzed and compared with the expected theoretical results. The FIR digital filter designed in this article can effectively filter out unnecessary frequency components and retain the signal components of interest. The results indicated that the design and simulation of FIR digital filters based on FPGA is a feasible and effective method. It can achieve filter performance that meets specific requirements and has broad application prospects. This study demonstrated that the design methods and simulation tools used can accurately simulate the behavior of FIR filters and meet design requirements and performance indicators.

articleTitle: Parameter Optimization of a Grounded DVA Model Based on Intelligent Particle Swarm Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Technology (CSAT)
abstract: This paper aims to study a basic grounded dynamic vibration absorber (DVA) model applied in practical engineering under the combination of theoretical analysis and intelligent optimization algorithm. The particle swarm optimization (PSO) algorithm searches for the optimal parameter values according to the objective function in continuous iteration and self-recognition. By optimizing the single variable, it can be found that the amplitude of the primary system after optimization is significantly reduced and reaches the effect of equal peaks. This attempt provides a reference for the vibration control and parameter optimization of vibration absorber.

articleTitle: QDSE: Question-Driven Semantic Enhancement for Logical Reasoning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Technology (CSAT)
abstract: In recent years, pretrained language models have demonstrated outstanding performance across various reading comprehension datasets. However, the logical reasoning task demands a higher level of logical reasoning ability. In many existing research methods, there is a tendency to concentrate on uncovering the logical structure between context and options while overlooking the crucial role of ‘questions.’ This paper proposes Question-Driven Semantic Enhancement (QDSE) to augment the semantic expression of context and options by utilizing questions as filters. Furthermore, our method can serve as available auxiliary modules for other methods based on token embedding. Experiments indicate that our method enhances the semantic information of token embedding, improving the performance of the baseline model.

articleTitle: An Integrated Aircraft Maintenance Training Platform Based on “Simulation Training+Auxiliary Operation”
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Technology (CSAT)
abstract: In view of the development of large, complex and technology-intensive aircraft, it has increased the difficulty of maintenance. A solution of integrated aircraft maintenance training platform based on “simulation training + auxiliary operation” is proposed. The architecture adopts the interface navigation control strategy based on the interface transformation matrix, and uses the non-secret surrogate image (two-dimensional code image) to obtain the identification information, which ensures the accurate positioning. The maintenance training concept, advanced technology and design scheme adopted in the research and development process of this project will certainly play a positive role in promoting the innovation of maintenance training means and the reform of training mode.

articleTitle: A Navigation System for Guiding Blind People in Indoor and Outdoor
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Technology (CSAT)
abstract: the development of navigation tools for blind people has become an important focus in the field of assistive technology research. This paper presents a navigation system for guiding blind people both in indoor and outdoor circumstance, the system consists of three parts, two vibration bracelets mounted on the user's hand wrist, a wearable intelligent device wearing in user's chest, the video cameras will realize the circumstance information and design an app be loaded in user's mobile phone, with synthetic speech output guiding blind people to the determine. We design a navigation system with positioning system, location based and image processing algorithms for orienting and tracking the position of blind people in complex environment.

articleTitle: Solar Image Denoising Using Non-Local Means Method
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Technology (CSAT)
abstract: Solar physics study relies on the high-resolution imaging observation. So, solar observed images are important to study solar physics. However, the observed solar images are usually disturbed by image noise, such as Gauss and salt-pepper noise. The denoise methods, such as image smooth, wavelet transforms, machine learning are used to remove the image noise. But the methods have usually some limitations. Therefore, we proposed a novel method using a non-local mean algorithm to remove solar image noise for improving solar image qualities. We revealed and evaluated our proposed method using the observation data taken by the Goode Solar Telescope (GST) at the Big Bear Solar Observatory (BBSO). The results prove that our proposed method is accurate and correct with respect to the solar image denoising.

articleTitle: Research on the Activity and Emission Characteristics of Tractor-Trailers Based on Remote Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Technology (CSAT)
abstract: By utilizing internet technology for real-time collection of motor vehicle emission running data, a modern technical means has been provided for studying motor vehicle emission status. In this article, we conducted research on the activity features and emission levels of China V heavy-duty tractors based on the car-mounted OBD system and remote data collection technology via the internet. The study found that heavy-duty tractors have a higher proportion of daytime operation and operate in the high-speed section. High NOx are concentrated in high-load and super high-speed working conditions, and the NOx emission rate of the vehicle under high-speed low-load conditions does not increase significantly. By conducting emission inspections during the day, reducing overloading, and increasing the average speed, we can effectively reduce the NOx emission level of vehicles.

articleTitle: Application Research of Temperature Control System of Small Container of Cigarette Pack based on Velocity Model
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Technology (CSAT)
abstract: [Background and purpose] At present, the small pack ironing container device used in the packaging workshop of cigarette factory generally has the problem that the temperature of the heating iron of the container fluctuates greatly when the vehicle speed changes, which leads to the difference in the filming of cellophane package due to the difference in temperature, and the beauty effect of the cigarette bag transparent paper is not ideal. [Method] The device collects the encoder signal of the packaging machine through the control system, calculates the speed value through the internal calculation, and sets up the mathematical model on the basis of the preliminary experimental data to realize the intelligent control of heating power. [Result] The control system can precisely control the temperature value of the beautiful container, so that the temperature of the soldering iron can keep the deviation within ±3°C in the process of speed change, and then improve the quality of the transparent paper of the small box cigarette bag.

articleTitle: Designing and Implement of Glow-Wire Temperature Control System Based on IMC-PID
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Technology (CSAT)
abstract: In this paper, the temperature control system of the glow wire test device is designed by using IMC-PID control method, and the simulation analysis, software and hardware implementation of the system are carried out. The test results show that the temperature control system has fast heating speed, short adjusting time and good dynamic performance.

articleTitle: Highway Traffic Flow Model Based on Control Theory
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Technology (CSAT)
abstract: Based on the macro-second-order traffic flow model and the control theory, this paper describes the relationship between vehicle density, traffic flow and average vehicle speed per unit section in a specific road section over time, calculates the on-ramp traffic flow, uses iterative learning control method to limit on-ramp flow, and adopts dynamic speed limit to effectively alleviate traffic jams and ensure efficient operation of expressways.

articleTitle: GSTCN: Graph-Based Spatial-Temporal Convolutional Networks for Advanced ENSO Forecasting
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Technology (CSAT)
abstract: The El Niño-Southern Oscillation (ENSO) phenomenon is one of the factors that has a major impact on global climate change. It may cause natural disasters such as floods, droughts, and heavy rainfall, and have a serious impact on public health. Therefore, how to accurately predict the ENSO phenomenon has become a top priority in current research and mitigation efforts. Although physical models and traditional statistical models can improve ENSO prediction capabilities, accurately predicting ENSO remains challenging due to the nonlinearity of ENSO. In recent years, the introduction of deep learning methods has brought new possibilities to ENSO prediction. In this paper, we utilize existing deep learning models to construct a novel spatiotemporal model called adaptive graph spatiotemporal convolutional network (GSTCN). We first develop a graph convolution space module to adapt it to the characteristics of evolving states. Furthermore, we introduce a time series module to capture the relationship between time series output and input. We conduct experiments on simulated and historical climate data sets, and the experimental results show that GSTCN outperforms contemporary deep learning models in ENSO prediction, with a 20-month prediction horizon.

articleTitle: A Demand Forecasting Method for High Value-Added Agri - Food Based on Machine Learning and Time Series Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Technology (CSAT)
abstract: This paper presents a hybrid method that combines machine learning and time series forecasting model techniques to enhance the precision and reliability of forecasts. After establishing a learning model for high value-added agri-food demand forecasting, we selected the annual demand for a certain high value-added agri-food as the target value. Other economic indicators, namely the National Income Index, population, and residents' consumption level, were chosen as the key influencing factors affecting product demand. We collected actual demand data sequences from Zhejiang Province for the years 2006–2022 as training and test samples. Comparing the forecasting results, it was found that this hybrid algorithm is an appropriate method for forecasting. Compared to other individual models, it demonstrates higher accuracy and lower mean absolute errors in predicting the demand for high value-added agri-food.

articleTitle: Preview Repetitive Control for Linear Discrete-Time Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Technology (CSAT)
abstract: This paper addresses the preview repetitive control (PRC) for discrete-time systems for a given previewed reference signal. Firstly, an augmented error system (AES) is constructed. Then, two kinds of PRC laws are proposed, and a two-dimensional (2D) model is presented. Using Lyapunov functions, sufficient conditions for asymptotic stability of the 2D system are derived and the designs of PRC laws are proposed via the LMI method. Finally, the effectiveness of our proposed PRC is illustrated by a numerical simulation examples.

articleTitle: Practice Research of Blended Teaching Mode Based on Virtual Simulation Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Technology (CSAT)
abstract: Objective: To explore the practical effect of blended teaching mode based on virtual simulation technology. How: The undergraduate students of grade 2021 majoring in nursing in our school were selected as the research objects. According to the convenient sampling method, classes 1 and 2 were set as the control group (n=84), and Classes 3 and 4 were set as the experimental group (n=84). The control group adopted the traditional teaching method, while the experimental group adopted the mixed teaching mode based on virtual simulation technology. The final exam scores, independent learning ability and the evaluation of teaching reform effect of the experimental group were compared. Results: The final examination scores and independent learning ability of the experimental group were higher than those of the control group (P < 0.05), and the satisfaction rate of the experimental group was 100%. Conclusion: The blended teaching mode based on virtual simulation technology has a good effect in practice, which can not only improve students' academic performance, but also help improve students' ability of independent learning, analysis and problem solving, and comprehensive application.

articleTitle: Sound Source Direction Localization Scheme on Smart Phones with Dual Microphones
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Technology (CSAT)
abstract: This article introduces a smartphone-based sound source localization scheme that leverages the dual microphones of smartphones. It collects signals emitted by sound sources using the upper and lower microphones of phones, estimates the time delay difference between the signals arriving at the two microphones through double generalized cross-correlation, analyzes the angle of arrival of the sound, and determines the sound source direction based on the geometric relationship between the sound source and the microphones. To address the issue of signal symmetry from sound sources on both the left and right sides reaching the microphones, this article incorporates certain functionalities from virtual audio techniques. It applies virtual rotation to the previously calculated sound source angles, creating an illusion of sound source rotation to distinguish between left and right sound sources. The primary contribution of this article is the proposition of the feasibility of sound source localization through smartphones and the utilization of a sound virtual rotation method to mitigate the symmetry issue in smartphone microphone signal collection. The experimental results validate the effectiveness and accuracy of the algorithm proposed in this article.

articleTitle: Research on Automation Operation and Maintenance Service Platform of Information System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Technology (CSAT)
abstract: In view of the problems exists in the operation and maintenance work of information system, such as variety of hardware, complexity of business system structure, lack of automatic monitor and troubleshooting measures. In order to improve efficiency of operation and maintenance, and to keep healthy operation of the information system, a automation operation and maintenance service platform of coal mine information systems was designed. The platform uses automated operation and maintenance tools Zabbix, real-time monitor running status and resource consumption of the servers, network devices, and applications, and uses variety of alarm methods to provide fault alert. The fault diagnosis and repair strategy is designed to achieve active operation and maintenance. The knowledge base of fault disposal methods based on Elasticsearch was designed, intelligent matching and push fault diagnosis and handle method to the maintainers, which improves the efficiency of fault repair.

articleTitle: Research on Full Link Monitoring and Fault Link Automatic Repair Based on Data Center
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Technology (CSAT)
abstract: In this paper, the data center is taken as the object of study, the whole link monitoring mechanism with the data center as the core is studied, the whole system structure of the data link monitoring is constructed, the link monitoring flow is explained, and the link automatic repair technology is used, the classification of link failure is realized, and corresponding maintenance methods are adopted for different faults. This paper takes the whole-link Monitoring System of data center station as the research object, breaks through the single monitoring means, establishes the whole-link monitoring capability, and promotes the formation of the whole-link monitoring and the automatic repair method of applaud link covering the whole life cycle of data.

articleTitle: Credit Card Fraud Detection Based on Fcm-Svmsmote-Cnn
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Technology (CSAT)
abstract: Traditional fraud detection methods mainly rely on models and rules, but these methods often cannot cope with the increasingly changing and more complex and hidden fraud means. Especially in all credit card transactions, fraudulent data only accounts for a small proportion. Faced with the problem of extremely imbalanced data distribution, traditional machine learning or deep learning methods may not achieve good detection results. To face the situation, this paper uses the FCM algorithm for clustering, the support vector machine synthesis minority oversampling technology (SVMSMOTE) to generate new synthetic samples, and then uses SMOTE oversampling to synthesize new minority samples manually to make the number of minority samples equal to the number of majority samples. Finally, an FCM-SVMSMOTE-CNN credit card transaction fraud prediction model is constructed. The research results show that the prediction model based on FCM-SVMSMOTE-CNN can recognize the potential fraudulent transaction information in a shorter period, and improve the anti-fraud ability of credit card companies such as banks.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of a Student Psychological Assessment and Counseling System Under Data Mining Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Technology (CSAT)
abstract: With the rapid development of Chinese society and the growing population, various competitions between people are also intensifying. The increasing social and life pressures faced by college students have led to increasingly prominent psychological issues. According to the 2022 psychological assessment of college students conducted by China People's Daily Online, nearly one-third of Chinese college students across China would suffer from serious psychological problems caused by life pressure, such as confusion and anxiety, frequent self-depression, conflicting interpersonal relationships, and the inability to vent their inner emotions normally. The mental health issues of college students would be a major issue in Chinese society, and it is necessary to develop an effective method to solve the psychological problems of college students, helping them better cope with the pressure from life. This article aims to study a student psychological assessment and counseling system based on data mining algorithms, in order to improve the ability of college students to withstand life and social pressure, and to enhance the scientific and effective aspects of college student psychological counseling. The continuous development and research of information technology, technology, and artificial intelligence, especially in the areas of big data and artificial intelligence, have provided tremendous assistance and technical support for conducting student psychological assessment and counseling work. The student psychological assessment and counseling system based on data mining algorithms can help students solve their own psychological problems faster and provide more humane and personalized counseling solutions for students. This article would be validated through simulation experiments and performance experiments of the student psychological assessment and counseling system. In the simulation experiment, the accuracy of the student psychological assessment and tutoring system under the data mining algorithm was higher than 90%. The recall rate is above 80%, with the highest accuracy rate of 99% and the highest recall rate of 99%. From this, it can be seen that the performance of the student psychological assessment and counseling system based on data mining algorithms is better, which can accurately evaluate the psychological status of students and provide a basis for their psychological counseling and plans.

articleTitle: Dynamic Access Control Algorithm to Detect and Defend Intrusion for IoT Nodes
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Technology (CSAT)
abstract: The Internet of Things (IoT) is the underlying technology that connects daily devices to the Internet and provides intelligent service facilities. These eye-catching figures make it an attractive playground for cybercriminals. In addition, IoT devices are built using resource constrained architectures to provide compact dimensions and competitive prices. Therefore, integrating complex network security features goes beyond the computing power of IoT. This article proposes an intrusion detection system (IDS) based on LSTM, which has a dynamic access control (DAC) algorithm that can not only detect intrusions but also defend against them. Unlike most IDS, the proposed IDS model is selected and optimized through mathematical analysis. In addition, it detects 14 types of security higher than other IDS. The accuracy, recall, and Fl scores are 97.0%, 97.1%, and 97.0%, respectively.

articleTitle: An Edge Computing-Based Data Collection Method for Smart Grid Data Acquisition System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Technology (CSAT)
abstract: As an increasing number of data collection devices being integrated into the power system, the volume of data to be uploaded to the cloud is also growing annually. This data plays a crucial role in the continuous operation of the power system. However, the current method of information exchange through IoT management platforms results in a significant amount of redundant data when dealing with a massive number of collection devices. This severely limits the further widespread application of smart devices. To address this issue, this paper proposes a device information acquisition method based on edge computing. Devices are categorized and clustered according to their nature. Subsequently, data compression is achieved by comparing and consolidating identical data. The algorithm considers the timeliness of the clustering process and establishes conditions for re-clustering based on empirical design. Finally, we designed a device data collection system based on this algorithm, demonstrating its feasibility.

articleTitle: A Study of Research Data and Metadata Standards in the Field of Humanities and Social Sciences
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Technology (CSAT)
abstract: This article analyses the characteristics of research data and metadata in the field of humanities and social sciences, and using the global registration center of the research database - re3data.org as the data source to retrieve and extract databases in this field, sorts out disciplines and extracts relevant information based on the research content, including the types of research data used and metadata schemes. Through analysis, it was found that Dublin Core, DataCite Metadata Schema, and DDI are currently the most commonly used metadata standards in the field of humanities and social sciences. However, scientific data in this field is as complex and diverse as other subjects. If delving into a specific subject, some data repositories have not yet been explained or suitable metadata solutions have not been found. It is worth further exploration whether a ‘universal’ metadata standard can be applied to most topics.

articleTitle: The Establishment of Tourism Parallel Corpus and Its Application in Teaching
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Technology (CSAT)
abstract: Corpus linguistics is an inter discipline incorporating with linguistic analysis, language education, research approach, statistic and information technology and etc. In recent years, the corpus has played an important role in education. This study discusses the specific steps of establishing tourism parallel corpus, mainly including corpus planning, collecting, denoising, alignment, tagging/segmentation and retrieval application by adopting various software such as ParaConc, CLAWS, and Corpus Word Parser. Besides, the self-built corpus finds its application in language teaching and learning.

articleTitle: Collaborative Optimization Measurement Method for Network Topology
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Technology (CSAT)
abstract: Cyberspace is the second space for human production and life, and also an important frontier of national sovereignty. As a “map” describing the distribution and connection of cyberspace elements, network topology is the basis for people to understand, utilize and manage cyberspace. Aiming at the problem of high redundancy of path probing in network topology discovery, which causes resource waste and network congestion, this paper proposed a collaborative probing method to optimize network topology measurement in large-scale. Compared to the traditional method, the proposed method is able to decrease the cost by more than 76% while remaining more than 80% link discovery rate and more than 96.5% node discovery rate. This study has practical significance for understanding the structure of cyberspace, improving the performance of cyberspace management and control, and enhancing the capability of confrontation in cyberspace.

articleTitle: Research on Topology Identification Method for Low Voltage Distribution Area Based on Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Technology (CSAT)
abstract: The topology structure of the low-voltage substation area is the foundation for conducting business such as line loss analysis, power supply repair, and load analysis. Due to the reconfiguration, maintenance, and repair of power lines, the topology structure of low-voltage substations may change. Therefore, it is of great practical significance to quickly and accurately obtain topology information of substations. This article proposes a new low-voltage substation topology identification method combining the law of energy conservation and genetic algorithm. Compared with traditional methods, this method does not require the addition of additional equipment, does not generate characteristic currents with interference characteristics, nor does it require high-frequency collection of electrical characteristics. It will not affect the normal business operation of the electricity information collection system and has the characteristics of low cost and easy implementation. Theoretical analysis and experimental simulation have shown that this method has significant advantages.

articleTitle: Improvement of Aluminum Foil Paper Transportation Stability for ZB45M Packaging Machine
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Technology (CSAT)
abstract: In order to meet market demand and reduce the capacity pressure of new medium cigarette, the stability of aluminum foil paper conveying in the ZB45M packaging machine has been improved. By optimizing the aluminum foil paper acceleration roller, improving the aluminum foil paper refueling device, and improving the aluminum foil paper semicircular knife cutting device, the operating speed of the equipment has been increased from 300 packages/minute to 335 packages/minute. The results show that after improvement, the number of packaging machine shutdowns has decreased by nearly 50%, the proportion of aluminum paper faults has decreased by more than 40%, and the proportion of aluminum foil paper conveying blockage has also decreased by 50%. The stability of aluminum foil paper conveying in packaging machines has greatly improved.

articleTitle: Enhancing Machine Learning in Information Security: Power-Law Distribution and Dragon King
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Technology (CSAT)
abstract: This paper addresses challenges in applying machine learning to information security, focusing on the pivotal role of training data quality. We investigate outlier removal, particularly in heavy-tailed distributions like those in malicious software families. Through a case study on malicious file identification, we identify a power-law distribution, posing a unique challenge. Inspired by Sornette's ‘dragon king’ concept, our analysis reveals these exceptional entities within malicious software families, which, when recognized as defaults, impact labeling consistency. Removing these outliers in power-law distribution improves machine learning model performance.

articleTitle: An Android Application Software Security Protection Method Based on Hybrid Reinforcement
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Technology (CSAT)
abstract: In order to protect the data security and prevent reverse attack, this paper proposes a comprehensive protection scheme for Android application software to solve the problems of data security and self security. In view of the data security hidden trouble, the scheme mainly carries on the resource file protection. Wherein, Resource file protection includes resource file path confusion and image compression. Aiming at the problem of reverse attack, the scheme is carried out from two aspects: Dex file reinforcement and So file reinforcement. The reinforcement of Dex file mainly includes the key code extraction encryption and dynamic loading of Dex file, and the rein-forcement of So file mainly includes So file encryption and compression. Experiments show that the proposed security protection scheme for Android application Software can resist most of the reverse analysis and dynamic debugging attacks.

articleTitle: Design of Centralized Monitoring System of Heat Supply Network Based on SCADA
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Technology (CSAT)
abstract: With the progress of society, the heating monitoring system needs to be more intelligent and humanized. This paper uses the latest intelligent and information technology to design the centralized monitoring system of heat supply network based on SCADA. Through the optimization of the structure of the central heating monitoring system, the realization of the intelligent automatic controlsystem of the heat exchange station, the realization of the rapid fault locationand remote assistance in the operation of the heating system, the safe releaseof the operation data and the establishment of a multi-level supervision system, the performance of the central heating monitoring system has been comprehensively improved. It improves the intelligence and information level of the system, reduces the work intensity of the operation and maintenance personnel, and saves the precious human resources.

articleTitle: Psychological Stress Assessment System under Big Data Analysis Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Technology (CSAT)
abstract: In response to the current high psychological pressure among people in society, but the shortage of psychological professionals, many people are unable to seek help, this article designs a psychological stress assessment system based on big data analysis technology. This article introduces genetic algorithms to optimize neural networks, addressing their shortcomings and enabling the psychological stress assessment system to have superior performance. Through experimental testing, it is found that the psychological stress evaluation system designed in this paper has high evaluation efficiency, strong stability, and strong noise resistance, and can effectively evaluate the psychological stress.

articleTitle: Application of TOA Cooperative Location Algorithm Based on Modified Chan and Taylor
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Technology (CSAT)
abstract: With special consideration of the demand of indoor location, this paper discussed a method which is based on UWB(Ultra Wide Band), TOA(Time of Arrival),and combines Chan's algorithm and Taylor series algorithm. Firstly, get a primary result by Chan's algorithm, take the result of the modified Chan's algorithm into Taylor series algorithm. The experimental results show that the method can improve the location accuracy and it has a good performance for indoor environment and can draw the real time position of object effectively.

articleTitle: Research on Surface Curvature Detection of Cigarette Packaging Paper Based on 3D Laser Scanning Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Technology (CSAT)
abstract: In view of the paper jam problem in the automatic production line of the packaging workshop of Nanning Cigarette Factory due to excessive surface curvature of the raw material of the packaging paper, this paper proposes to use 3D laser scanning technology to scan and obtain the depth map data of the surface of the packaging paper to be detected and use a deep learning model to segment the detection package and the platform plane. Then the depth map is converted to obtain the 3D point cloud data. Coarse and fine noise reduction is carried out on the obtained point cloud data, and the coordinates of the highest point cloud and the line and plane Angle formed by the line with the base point and the horizontal plane can be calculated to obtain the curvature data of the cigarette box raw materials and achieve non-contact and high-precision curvature measurement. The application of this technology has effectively solved the problem of paper jam in the production line of Nanning Cigarette Factory and has produced better economic and social benefits.

articleTitle: Moderate Deviations for the Randomly Weighted Sums with Arbitrary Dependence between the Primary Random Variables and Counting Process
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Technology (CSAT)
abstract: We study moderate deviations for the randomly weighted sums, where the primary random variables are consistently-varying-tailed, the weights have two-sided bounds, and the linear Hawkes counting process is not necessarily independent of the primary random variables and the weights, the primary random variables and the weights is independent. The conclusion shows that the dependence between the counting process and the primary random variables and the weights have no effects on the asymptotic behavior of moderate deviation of random weighted sums.

articleTitle: Design of an Intelligent Parts Sorting System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Technology (CSAT)
abstract: Intelligent manufacturing of steel structure is the key development direction of high-end manufacturing industry and an important embodiment of the deep integration of information technology and industrialization. The identification, quality inspection and classification of steel plates for a large number of various parts are important components in the production of steel structures. Traditional manual work, labor intensity, and directly affect the quality and efficiency of production. In this paper, an online intelligent parts sorting system for building steel structure is designed. Through system architecture innovation, APC controller is used to replace the traditional PLC+ host computer mode. The use of sub-core technology one machine multi-purpose, the complex operation process is simplified and intelligent. The huge manual labor intensity to achieve mechanization, automation.

articleTitle: Application of Virtual Reality Technology Based on Unity in Environmental Art Design
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Technology (CSAT)
abstract: Virtual reality (VR) technology possesses strong interactivity and immersiveness, capable of simulating the real world and providing people with a virtual environment indistinguishable from reality. In recent years, it has increasingly garnered the attention of technologists, especially in the field of environmental art design (EAD). Designers applying virtual reality technology in environmental art can present their designs more intuitively, allowing for a more direct experience for the audience. Building on this, the article first introduces the current application and characteristics of virtual reality technology in environmental art design, and delves into the application of the Unity engine in this field. The results of the experiments show that the use of the Unity engine in environmental art design has achieved a high innovation score of up to 91.1. This paper is of significant importance for the development of environmental art design, providing valuable guidance for researchers and designers.

articleTitle: Application of BIM Virtual Simulation Technology in Architectural Practice under the Background of Digital Transformation
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Technology (CSAT)
abstract: Against the backdrop of digital transformation, the rapid advancement of Building Information Modeling (BIM) technology is leading new trends in architectural industry practice and educational guidance. This paper revolves around the theme of “Application of BIM Virtual Simulation Technology in Architectural Practice under the Background of Digital Transformation”, exploring the use of BIM technology in architectural education and guidance. The article begins with an overview of the development history of BIM technology and its current status in the architectural field, followed by an in-depth analysis of the advantages of BIM virtual simulation technology in the educational guidance process. It discusses challenges encountered in practical applications, such as inadequacy of training, software costs, and compatibility issues, and proposes corresponding solutions including strengthening guidance methods that integrate theory and practice, updating educational resources, and establishing industry collaborations. Through empirical research, this paper confirms the significant impact of BIM virtual simulation technology in enhancing students' learning interest and practical operation skills, and emphasizes its key role in cultivating high-quality professional talents for the future architectural industry. Overall, this study provides deep insights into the application of BIM technology in architectural education and practice, offering a theoretical foundation for future related practical directions.

articleTitle: Automatic Discovery Technology for Full Business Scenario Links in Cloud Environment
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Technology (CSAT)
abstract: Cloud computing, as an emerging hot topic in the current IT (Information Technology) industry, has received high attention from all sectors of society. The concept of cloud computing has been around for several years, and major companies have been utilizing virtualization technology to provide users with massive virtual computing and storage resources. With the development of computer virtualization technology, computing resources such as virtual machines in cloud computing are rapidly growing. To meet the increasingly diverse application needs, dynamic deployment is often required on massive computing resources. How to migrate existing services to cloud computing platforms is a very complex and large-scale research task, and the core issue is how to achieve automatic deployment of multiple components on cloud computing platforms. This method can not only reduce the false alarm rate during manual deployment, but also adapt to the complex and ever-changing demand characteristics in cloud computing, and more effectively achieve resource horizontal expansion. Therefore, this article explored the design of cloud resource scheduling algorithms for Service Level Agreement (SLA) to support automatic deployment of services on cloud platforms. Through experiments, it was verified that when the task length was 8*100*3600, the throughput of Hill Climbing algorithm, Simulated Annealing algorithm, and MSDA (Multiple Source Data Analysis) algorithm was 800 tasks/second, 900 tasks/second, and 1000 tasks/second, respectively, The throughput performance of cloud data centers was superior to other algorithms.

articleTitle: Research on the Directionality of a Cylindrical Array of Transducers Used for Navigation Type Ultrasound Catheters
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Technology (CSAT)
abstract: In this paper, a cylindrical array transducer structure composed of rectangular elements with radial vibration mode was proposed. The cylindrical array was equivalent to a combination of linear and convex arrays by a step-by-step method. Using the directionality function as an evaluation criterion, transducers with different element sizes, quantities, and spacing were tested, analyzed, and compared for their directionality. It lays a foundation for using SRCNN algorithm to control the Image resolution to be almost constant in the depth range, and helps to quickly determine the suitable transducer cylindrical array for generating left atrial images.

articleTitle: Research on Efficient and Trustworthy Traceability Methods for Agricultural Product Quality and Safety
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Technology (CSAT)
abstract: As the competition in the agricultural market becomes more and more intense, the quality, yield, competitive advantages and regional brands of agricultural products in traditional production areas are facing great risks and challenges due to the continuous cultivation of agricultural products for a long period of time and the many problems arising from the production and marketing process. In order to ensure the quality and safety of agricultural products in each link “from farm to table”, the traceability system of agricultural products has been gradually recognized by people, which solves the problem of low trust of consumers in agricultural products and food safety. However, the low efficiency of current agricultural product traceability methods and the strong dependence on centralized servers make traceability face a lot of challenges in the promotion of its practical application. faces many challenges. Therefore, this paper attempts to study blockchain technology and integrate it into the agricultural product traceability system to optimize the trustworthiness and security of the traditional agricultural product traceability model, achieve the safe storage of traceability confidentiality data, and improve the data storage and query performance. The research on safe and efficient traceability model based on blockchain aims at the problems of low data security, low credibility, and broken chain of supply chain information that exist in the traditional traceability process, and constructs a blockchain-based agricultural product quality and safety traceability system through the directional collection of agricultural product production process data, third-party testing data, and supply chain logistics and sales data. It lays a solid foundation for enhancing the reputation, influence and brand value of agricultural products, further boosting the development of related industries and enhancing the economic benefits of local agricultural products industry.

articleTitle: Intelligent Network Threat Detection Engine Based on Open Source GPT-2 Model
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Technology (CSAT)
abstract: The GPT -2 model, built upon the Transformer architecture, is a generative pre-training model that undergoes extensive unsupervised learning on vast amounts of text data. This training equips it with the capability to comprehend and generate natural language text. In recent years, the significance of network security has surged, accompanied by a surge in various network attacks such as XSS and DDoS attacks, causing substantial cumulative losses reaching hundreds of millions of dollars. To fortify the defenses of network security, this article introduces an innovative approach that harnesses the power of the GPT-2 model to enhance the efficiency and accuracy of network threat detection. This engine can discern and interpret data streams within networks through its pre-training on extensive datasets, enabling it to issue early warnings for specific threats. Comprehensive testing has demonstrated that the system is seamlessly adaptable to the Internet of Things and various Internet-connected devices, effectively providing preemptive alerts.

articleTitle: Development of Cylinder Head Assembly of Rotary Valve Engine Based on 3D Printing Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Technology (CSAT)
abstract: Based on 3D printing technology, a cylinder head assembly of rotary valve engine was developed and trial- produced in this paper. The structure of the assembly, the lubrication system, sealing system and cooling system are designed. Using 3D metal printing technology, the production of sample blank is completed, and the machining centre is used to complete the finishing of parts. The structural rationality of the design and the feasibility of 3D metal printing are verified by the installation. This study can provide some reference for the design and development of new power system.

articleTitle: Computer Vision-Based Damage Identification and Structural Analysis of a Practical Transmission Tower
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Technology (CSAT)
abstract: For the purpose of field inspection and maintenance of transmission towers, computer vision-based damage identification and structural analysis method is proposed in this paper. Bending detection of tower members mainly includes the procedures of mask making, edge and contour detecting, and curving fitting. In the detection task of a damaged tower, the proposed method showed good robustness, and states of members were concluded according to Guide. Based on finite element analysis, a coefficient c<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">j</inf> is defined as the product of state variability, risk of fail, and the relevance to the damaged element, which is able to describe association of members with the damaged one. Cases analysis with main member failing at different height showed that main members below cross arms, especially in the middle of tower have more associated elements, and should be paid more attention during inspection and maintenance.

articleTitle: The Role of Computer Modelling Measurement Techniques in Experimental Testing of Energy Consumption in Green Buildings
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Technology (CSAT)
abstract: The role of computer modelling in the green energy laboratory testing of the Shangri-La Elderly Apartments building recently completed by the Green Building Centre Institute is discussed. Through Ecotect calculations, an innovative Energy Enhanced Computer Model (EITM) was constructed, and computer modelling techniques were applied throughout the experiment, from the design of the test framework to the analysis of the generated data. Predictions from a series of finite element models of house maintenance structures were combined with a local green building approach, and the experimental data were simulated and analysed. The use of computer model-generated finite element simulations to help reduce the energy consumption of the house and optimise the building model is discussed, providing a reasonable measure of the computer model. In this study, we report on a run-through of the use of the (EITM) model in a test framework for experimental testing of energy consumption functional units in green buildings, demonstrate the advantages of the computer model metrics performance and summarise the computational simulation methodology with respect to the treatment of the model variables, energy consumption reduction and model reconstruction.

articleTitle: Fact-CoT: Explicit Fact-Enhanced Chain-of-Thought Prompting for Commonsense Reasoning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Technology (CSAT)
abstract: We improved the Chain-of-Thought prompting by simply adding a few sets of facts for every exemplar to tackle commonsense reasoning tasks. Experiments show this self-enhancement method can notably promote LMs' reasoning abilities. We explored the mechanism of this improvement and found that explicitly enumerating facts was more effective than implicitly mentioning them in the reasoning process.
