articleTitle: Research on Rotor Speed Optimization Strategy of TiltRotor Aircraft based on IPSO-SQP Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Technology (CSAT)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the rotor speed changes due to the conversion of flight mode during the full envelope flight of the tilt-rotor aircraft, this paper proposes a method to optimize the rotor speed based on the IPSO-SQP algorithm according to the comprehensive performance index of the aircraft. Firstly, the vertical and vertical force analysis of the tilt-rotor aircraft is carried out, and the influence of the change of the rotor speed on the performance of the aircraft is analyzed. Based on this, a comprehensive performance index function is established for the tilt-rotor aircraft, and the equality constraints and inequality constraints of the optimization problem are given through analysis. Furthermore, according to the comprehensive performance index function and constraint conditions, the rotor speed of the aircraft is optimized based on the IPSO-SQP algorithm. Finally, the optimal rotor speed change trajectory of the designed comprehensive performance index function is obtained under the premise of satisfying each constraint condition and ensuring the safety of the aircraft. Finally, taking XV-15 as the simulation research object, the improvement of the performance of the aircraft by optimizing the rotor speed change trajectory is verified by the full envelope flight simulation.

articleTitle: High-Tech Industry Employees Turnover Intention Prediction Model Based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Technology (CSAT)
abstract: This article uses machine learning methods to establish the prediction model of the high-tech industry employee turnover tendency. Firstly, ridge regression analysis and the XGBoost algorithm are used to explore the factors affecting the turnover intention of high-tech industry employees. Then, a predictive model was established using ridge regression, and the XGBoost algorithm was used to predict employee turnover trends in the high-tech industry on the test set. Through ridge regression analysis and the XGBoost algorithm, it is found that the most important factor affecting high-tech industry employees' turnover intention is workplace interpersonal relationships. Therefore, the first step in reducing the willingness of the high-tech industry employee turnover intention is to strengthen employees' interpersonal relationships in the workplace. The prediction evaluation results of the XGBoost algorithm on high-tech industry employee turnover tendency indicate that the algorithm has good prediction ability, small prediction error, and strong data interpretation ability.

articleTitle: Research on Radiation Emission Detection Method of Lithography Machine Subsystem
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Technology (CSAT)
abstract: The electromagnetic compatibility test of the lithography machine subsystem is different from the testing of traditional products in the laboratory, especially the radiation emission test, which cannot be tested in a darkroom. Therefore, there are very high requirements for system layout, limit value selection, on-site noise investigation, etc. This article combines military standards to test and study the radiation emission of the lithography machine subsystem, in order to improve the electromagnetic compatibility of the lithography machine subsystem and provide reference opinions for the testing industry.

articleTitle: Survey on Image-Oriented Transmission Line Inspection via UAV
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Technology (CSAT)
abstract: Unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) is exploited gi-gantically to substitute the human beings in the wild natural working environments to face the challenges of severe climate situations and low job efficiency. This paper surveys the reported applications of UAV in long-distance transmission line inspection via the research and techniques in image processing. It discusses the major pros and cons of the state of the art methods and discloses the future working directions to benefit the research domain.

articleTitle: Large Field of View Ship Moving Target Detection Based on Track Adaptive Maintenance
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Technology (CSAT)
abstract: Optical remote sensing images are easily disturbed by clouds and waves, and the sea scene changes greatly. It is a difficult problem to realize the robust and accurate detection of ship targets. Aiming at the application of moving ship target detection in multi frame sequence optical large field of view remote sensing images, a ship detection and tracking method based on feature analysis and motion estimation is proposed in this paper. In this paper, an ocean abnormal target detector is designed, which uses the combination of multiple features to quickly screen the target, then predicts the target position combined with motion estimation, uses FHOG features to confirm the identity, and finally discriminates the moving target twice through multi frame trajectory correlation. The proposed method is suitable for continuous monitoring and tracking of small moving targets in large field of view images. Multiple groups of remote sensing images are used for testing. The experimental results show that the average accuracy of this method is 74.9%, which is 0.7%, 1.3% and 8.4% higher than the traditional KCF, DSST and HOG + SVM methods respectively, and the operation time is significantly reduced. This method has good robustness, has the function of re discrimination after frame loss, and is suitable for satellite engineering applications.

articleTitle: Research on Heat Dissipation Simulation of Glare Device Based on Ansys-Icepak
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Technology (CSAT)
abstract: [Objective] To study the heat dissipation characteristics of high-light blinding device. [Methods] Firstly, the heat dissipation design of the internal structure was carried out to improve the internal air flow channel, and the forced air cooling design idea of internal circulation and external circulation was adopted. Secondly, the optimal fin layout and fin height, thickness, number, spacing and other technical parameters were obtained by simulation analysis of a variety of cooling fins. Finally, the air flow required by forced air cooling was calculated through theoretical analysis, and the appropriate fan was selected according to the air flow. [Results] The research shows that the fin adopts the form of parallel rectangular line, which can achieve the best heat absorption and heat dissipation effect. [Conclusion] In the heat dissipation design, the combination of conduction heat dissipation and forced air cooling heat dissipation can improve the heat dissipation effect of high-light blinding device to a certain extent.

articleTitle: Design of Mental Health Consultation System Based on Deep Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Technology (CSAT)
abstract: According to last year's National Mental Health Survey report, mental health risks decrease with age and income, and various occupational groups have different mental health characteristics. Mental health problems are increasingly prevalent among young people. Neural networks are being considered for application in the design of consulting systems due to their excellent performance and good stability. The frequent occurrence of mental health problems has prompted the rise of psychological counseling. In order to solve the problem of low efficiency caused by the large number of psychological counseling visits, this article uses deep learning algorithms to design and optimize the counseling system. Through the exploration of deep learning, this article compares the accuracy of the data results obtained by sum pooling and max pooling strategies, and then analyzes the performance of KNN (K-Nearest Neighbors), DNN (Deep Neural Networks) and Text CNN (Text Convolutional Neural Network) in mental health consultation systems. According to the experimental results, the accuracy, F1 value, recall rate and precision indicators of TextCNN are all 0.7 and above. Therefore, this article improves the Text CNN method by introducing attention mechanism, momentum improvement and stochastic gradient algorithm.

articleTitle: Detection of Malicious URL Based on BERT-CNN
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Technology (CSAT)
abstract: Disguising the content of the website service often lures users to visit the website URL, and malicious attacks are carried out on the user's computer, exposing the user to many security risks when using the Internet. At present, methods based on machine learning and some methods based on deep learning are inefficient and cannot accurately detect malicious URLs. To address the problem, we propose a detection method that combines BERT and CNN, termed as Malicious URL Detection based on BERT-CNN, which firstly segments the URL based on the WordPiece model, then obtains the embedding based on the pretrained model BERT, and finally connects CNNs with three convolution kernels after the BERT output layer to construct a BERT-CNN-based detection model. Experimental results show that the method outperforms the random forest, CNN, LSTM and BERT methods, indicating the proposed method can effectively detect malicious URLs.

articleTitle: Research on Four-Dimensional Flight Guidance and Control Technology of Helicopter
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Technology (CSAT)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of poor autonomous flight performance and low control precision of traditional helicopter. In this paper, taking the Black Hawk helicopter as the research example, the six-degree-of-freedom helicopter model is established, the helicopter four-dimensional flight guidance and control system is designed, and the helicopter four-dimensional flight guidance and control technology is studied. The simulation results show that the helicopter four-dimensional flight guidance and control system can track the four-dimensional flight trajectory effectively, and the research results can improve the autonomous flight performance of the helicopter. Especially the ability of four-dimensional flight mission execution has a certain reference significance.

articleTitle: The Design of the Control System for Equipment of Drilling-Tapping Once Shaping
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Technology (CSAT)
abstract: By utilizing the existing relatively mature CNC technology and combining with a new type of composite tool, the two processes of drilling and tapping in the process of machining threaded holes can be completed in one forming method, which can greatly improve production efficiency. As the tool's descending speed must be strictly matched with its rotational speed during thread formation, this system must adopt digital control method to achieve this matching. The specific method is to measure the spindle's rotational speed constantly during tapping, calculate the distance that the tool should descend based on this rotational speed and the specified pitch, use this as the control quantity to calculate the speed of the stepper motor, output it to the stepper motor, and drive the tool to complete the threading work.

articleTitle: Research on Optimal Layout Formation Techniques for Dynamic Planning of Single-Line Diagrams
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Technology (CSAT)
abstract: A method based on dynamic programming algorithm to get the optimal layout solution to realize the generation of single-line diagram of regional power grid is proposed. A topological model is constructed based on the spatial data of the grid, a breadth-first algorithm is implemented to obtain multiple adjacency matrices and matrix traversal sequences that can form a connectivity map, and a square range that can accommodate all the equipments is computed based on the width of the adjacency matrices, and a mathematical model is established with the minimum spacing of equipments as the optimization objective. An algorithm for solving the optimal layout of dynamic programming is proposed, which is applied to solve the optimal layout array and finally orthogonalized according to the principle of least-crossing. The application example shows that the layout by the optimal solution is beautiful and efficient.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic Compatibility Design of Reinforced LCD
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Technology (CSAT)
abstract: As the display terminal of military electronic equipment.reinforced liquid crystal display is one of the most direct,main and important key equipment for military personnel to obtain information. In the face of the most complex and severe command and control cabin environment of aircraft,combat vehicles and ships,reinforced liquid crystal display is interfered by and against other equipment all the time. Sudden equipment restart,flash screen,flower screen and other failures,seriously affect the normal operation of equipment,further affect the battlefield judgment of military personnel. This paper summarizes the main functions and working principles of the reinforced LCD,and puts forward the design scheme for the electromagnetic compatibility problems of the reinforced LCD. It is necessary to consider the electromagnetic compatibility at the beginning of the design,reduce the interference and interference risk of the equipment from the source side,and rationally lay out the equipment inside to achieve the ideal electromagnetic compatibility effect..

articleTitle: Eu Certified RF Testing Requirements for Wireless Communication Products Using WiFi Protocol
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Technology (CSAT)
abstract: The evolution of wireless communication technology has brought about continuous upgrades of communication standard versions. Wireless communication products exported to the European market must pass the EU's Radio Equipment Directive certification, with RF testing being particularly important. This article takes wireless communication products with WiFi 2.4 GHz function as an example to introduce RF testing requirements, providing reference for relevant enterprises and technical personnel.

articleTitle: Construction Study on Intelligent Energy Safety Operation and Maintenance System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Technology (CSAT)
abstract: Based on the current energy situation of the world, the safety operation and maintenance needs of users are more and more important. Considering the hysteresis and passivity defects existing in the traditional energy safety operation and maintenance system, this paper analyzes an intelligent energy safety operation and maintenance system by combining modern Internet communication technologies. Firstly, a five-dimensional spatio-temporal database is established with historical and real-time data through the ‘cloud-edge-to-end’ data collection system. Then, data optimization is worked based on intelligent algorithms such as PCA, PSO and etc., which can achieve the automatic scene recognition and diagnosis. The intelligent energy safety operation and maintenance system proposed in this paper can quickly and accurately diagnose energy usage scenarios based on real-time operation data, intelligent identification of faults and optimal operating conditions, which can achieve the goal of ensuring the safe operation of equipment.

articleTitle: Electrical Characteristics of Floating-Body and Body-Contacted Silicon-On-Insulator N-Channel Transistor
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Technology (CSAT)
abstract: In this paper, Sentaurus TCAD simulation was utilized to study the electrical characteristics of floating body and body contact SOI devices. The short channel effect, subthreshold slope, transconductance, DIBL and on-off current of floating body and body contact SOI devices were compared and analyzed, which provides guidance for device design and optimization. At the same time, TCAD numerical simulation results are used to compare the floating body effect characteristics of the two devices.

articleTitle: Design of Hybrid Cross Chain Scheme Based on Relay Chain
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Technology (CSAT)
abstract: This paper focuses on the problem that nodes are prone to repeated verification in crosschain transactions of relay chain, which leads to the collective shutdown of nodes. It proposes a crosschain transaction matching algorithm to solve the problem of low efficiency and success rate of data matching, and introduces and optimizes the Raft consensus algorithm to improve the efficiency of crosschain communication interaction. Through the intelligent contract based on Ethereum, the crosschain system of experimental data center sharing mode is simulated, which shows that the extra delay introduced by crosschain mechanism accounts for a relatively small proportion of the total time consumption, and its efficiency and excellent performance are verified.

articleTitle: An Empirical Study on Quantitative Analysis of Legal Literature Based on Artificial Intelligence Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Technology (CSAT)
abstract: At the level of national governance, legal studies are, to a certain extent, inextricably linked to the goal of modernizing the national governance system. For the study of legal literature, the use of quantitative research methods can summarize the types of literature journals, the direction of selected topics, and the number of publications, etc. The qualitative research methods can observe the points of contention and consensus in the academic community on the construction of the legal system and the positioning of the discipline. With the continuous development of modern science and technology, there are more and more kinds of artificial intelligence algorithms, including ant colony algorithm, genetic algorithm, reinforcement learning, deep learning, logistic regression and decision tree, among which CI index is an important index. Therefore, based on the artificial intelligence algorithm, this paper selected the historical publication data of law disciplines of six universities in China's political science and law, and evaluated the influence of a single literature by using the CI index theoretical model. Based on the horizontal comparison of the overall scientific research level in terms of “quality” and “quantity” of each university's literature, some index algorithms of the model could be modified to obtain an objective picture of the current scientific research level of universities. The results show that the evaluation method based on artificial intelligence algorithms has the advantages of easy access to data, strong operability and few indicators, which is worth promoting and applying.

articleTitle: The Automatic Generation Algorithm for Single Line Diagrams of Distribution Networks Based on the Layout Model of Branch and Main Lines
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Technology (CSAT)
abstract: To enhance the automatic generation capability of SLD (single line diagram) for distribution networks, an automatic generation algorithm for SLD of distribution networks based on the layout model of branch and main lines was proposed. The automatic wiring control of the distribution network's SLD was performed by incorporating the individual differential characteristic quantities of distribution equipment. During load conditions, the topology structure of the distribution network's single line networking was designed, and the attribute correlation characteristic quantities output by branch and main line nodes in the distribution network's SLD were extracted. This process utilized a connectivity index distribution model between distribution equipment and the distribution network to optimize the positioning design of wiring nodes. Under the layout model of branch and main lines, the automatic fusion control of single line diagrams of distribution networks was carried out. Based on the network structure and operation situation, the automatic configuration and positioning design of distribution network's SLD were carried out and the automatic positioning model of distribution network's SLD was analyzed. By combining fuzzy detection and optimization control methods, the key characteristic selection method of distribution networks was adopted to optimize the deployment design of nodes in the automatic generation process of branch and main lines of distribution network's SLD, achieving the automatic generation of distribution network's SLD. The simulation results showed that using this method for automatic generation of single line diagrams of distribution networks had good optimization ability and strong node optimization deployment ability, and improved the efficiency of distribution network design.

Author Keywords: Layout of branch and main lines

articleTitle: DF-Net: A Defect Detection Method of Ceramic Tile Printing Texture Based on Multi-Label Classification
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Technology (CSAT)
abstract: Industrial defect detection is one of the important technologies in the field of intelligent manufacturing. The detection of surface defects on ceramic tiles is an important quality control task in industrial defect detection. In view of the problems of false detection and missed detection caused by the unclear characteristics and uneven categories of ceramic tile printing texture defects in industrial defect detection, a data processing method based on multi-label classification is proposed. The neural network model DF-Net and improved cross-entropy loss function for ceramic tile printing texture defect detection achieve an accuracy rate of 82.9% in the ceramic tile image dataset, while reducing the inference time per 416×128 resolution image to 0.03s, achieving efficient and accurate detection of ceramic tile printing texture defects.

articleTitle: DetMLB: Network Traffic Detection System and Detector Load Balancing Method Under microservice Architecture
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Technology (CSAT)
abstract: Traditional monolithic application development model suffers from tight coupling, limited scalability, and difficulty in deployment and updating, while the modular and distributed features of microservice architecture make it ideal for building applications. Meanwhile, in order to cope with the ever-growing and unpredictable network attacks, we implemented a network traffic detection system based on the microservice architecture, and ensured the independent deployment and update of the system, which enhanced the maintainability, scalability and flexibility of the system. In addition, we have added a load balancing machine in the detection module to improve the detection efficiency of the detector and the utilisation of device resources.

articleTitle: Development and Application of Real-Time Monitoring System for Energy Consumption and Carbon Emission in Construction Group Based on Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Technology (CSAT)
abstract: In order to realize the carbon emission monitoring and management objectives of construction enterprises, and help realize the informatization, dativization and visualization of carbon emission monitoring and management of construction group, this paper is based on the Internet of Things (IoT) technology, and develops a carbon emission monitoring platform with systems such as carbon emission data collection and entry, real-time monitoring of energy consumption through IoT, and multilevel data display boards, etc., which can realize the collection and calculation of energy consumption and carbon emission data, analysis, display, and reporting of the data. Exporting. The platform has been demonstrated and applied in many projects. Practice has proved that the carbon emission monitoring and management platform developed in this paper has good application value and promotion prospect.

articleTitle: Research on Autorotation Flight Control Technology of Unmanned Helicopters
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Technology (CSAT)
abstract: In response to the difficulty of maintaining attitude stability and trajectory tracking flight during the helicopter's self rotating glide process, a cascade control method was adopted to design a helicopter's self rotating controller. Firstly, an improved LQR based attitude controller is used in the inner loop to enhance the stability and robustness of the helicopter attitude. Then, a trajectory tracking controller based on MPC is used in the outer loop, and the optimal control quantity is obtained through a recurrent neural network to achieve the function of autorotation and glide trajectory tracking. Finally, the effectiveness and robustness of the controller were verified by adding sensor noise interference and external gust interference.

articleTitle: Research on Improving Method of RCT-YOLOv5s Network for Surface Defect Extraction of Steel Wire Rope
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Technology (CSAT)
abstract: According to the particularity of steel wire rope surface defects., several YOLO models were analysed and then YOLOv5s was selected as the basis to improve in this paper: To enhance the capability of defect feature extraction., RepVGG was used to replace two C3 units of network Backbone; To improve the ability of multi-scale feature expression., CoTN was used to replace C3 unit of Neck; In order to improve the recognition accuracy of small defects., a small target detection head was added to the head in network. At the same time., the loss function EIoU was used to instead of CIoU to achieve the goal that the detection accuracy and the defect detection speed was improved. It was shown from the experimental results that the new RCT-YOLOv5s network can improve the accuracy of surface defect of steel wire rope, especially for tiny defects, and the recognition accuracy of the surface defect of steel wire rope was improve by 4.5% compared with that of using the basic YOLOv5s.

articleTitle: Application of Computer Aided X-Ray Detection to Graphite Defects
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Technology (CSAT)
abstract: With the development of digital technology, the traditional non-destructive ray testing technology is developing to a higher and new technology. In this paper, a computer algorithm, image background subtraction method and large template convolution smoothing method are used to construct the image background, subtract the background image from the original image, and then filter the image to remove excess noise points, set a single threshold, perform binary processing and conversion of the image, mark the connected area of the image, and obtain a clearer defect image than the traditional technology. In this paper, a computer aided X-ray detection system is used to extract images of pores and cracks in graphite specimens, and some characteristic parameters are used to identify defect types, so as to facilitate further processing of the specimens.

articleTitle: A Cloud Computing Based Digital Storage and Evaluation Platform for Buddhist Literature
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Technology (CSAT)
abstract: The core content of establishing a digital platform for Buddhist literature archives is to manage massive Buddhist literature archives and establish a data center that can support the unified storage and management of heterogeneous data, which is the foundation of this platform. This article studied the current Buddhist literature resource storage model and analyzed its shortcomings. By combining it with cloud storage technology, a digital storage and analysis platform for Buddhist literature based on cloud computing was constructed. A thorough analysis was conducted on the functional requirements of the Buddhist literature digital storage and analysis platform for cloud computing, and corresponding functional designs were carried out. Multiple aspects such as hardware consumption, processing speed, system resource occupancy, bandwidth consumption, user experience, and resource security were tested and compared, and its advantages were finally summarized. In the user experience, 10 experts were invited for review, and 81.23% were very satisfied. This research platform contributes to the dissemination of Buddhist culture.

articleTitle: Research on Flight Control Technology of High Speed Helicopter based on Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Technology (CSAT)
abstract: In view of the problem of auto-disturbance rejection flight control of compound coaxial high speed helicopter, the maneuvering methods in different flight stages are analyzed first. Then, based on ADRC control theory, using the idea of cascade control, the controller design is analyzed for inner loop attitude control and outer loop speed/position control. Besides, the ADRC parameters are adjusted by DQN algorithm. Finally, MATLAB mathematical simulation is carried out to verify and analyze the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed scheme.

articleTitle: Design of English Speaking Training System Based on Human-Computer Interaction
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Technology (CSAT)
abstract: How to solve the lack of realtime feedback in oral training has always been a difficult problem. Human-computer interaction is very effective in providing flexibility, personalized support and realtime feedback to the system. This paper uses advanced voice input and recognition technology to accurately transcribe the learner's spoken expression, and then uses voice output and synthesis technology to communicate the voice feedback generated by the system to the learner, and finally realizes the realtime feedback and evaluation function, and gives accurate assessments and suggestions by analyzing the learner's spoken expression. After systematic testing, the pronunciation accuracy rate of students using the human-computer interaction system is 0.3-0.5. The personalized learning support and realtime feedback functions of the system help learners self-correct and improve their oral skills.

articleTitle: A No-Reference Image Quality Assessment Methodology Based on Distortion Information Extraction
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Technology (CSAT)
abstract: This paper establishes, through the principles of signal and system theory, that under the DMOS evaluation standard, image quality assessment is exclusively linked to distortion information. We introduce a novel image quality assessment model based on the Denoising Diffusion Probability Model (DDPM). This model utilizes the de noising autoencoder from DDPM for extracting image noise, coupled with a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) for quality evaluation. By isolating distortion information, the interference from redundant information is minimized, enhancing the efficiency of model training. The model demonstrates superior performance across five datasets, comprising both synthetic and real distortions.

articleTitle: Tailless Flying Wing UA V Buzz Response Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Technology (CSAT)
abstract: The tailless flying wing UA V buzz responses were studied based on CFD/CSD coupling method. The finite element methods and RANS N-S equations which based on the structural model and aerodynamic model were builded. The aerodynamic unstructured dynamic meshes based on the combination of the spring-based smoothing and local remeshing methods was used to calculate the aerodynamic force. The tailless flying wing UA V buzz responses based on the structural and aerodynamic coupling method was studied, and the tailless flying wing UA V rudder buzz response was also studied.

articleTitle: Diagnosis and Prediction of Servo Motor System of High Speed Winder Based on SiePA
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Technology (CSAT)
abstract: The new domestic ultra-high speed cigarette machine uses a large number of independent servo motor systems to achieve the precise control of each transmission mechanism and cigarette drum, which puts forward higher requirements for the use and maintenance level of motor components. For the motor servo system, this paper puts forward a set of diagnosis and prediction system scheme on the basis of Siemens SiePA, achieve the servo motor system life cycle preventive maintenance management through multi-dimensional data association, artificial intelligence model establishment, complete the servo motor system health value assessment and fault diagnosis and prediction, help the factory to improve the level of operation and maintenance effectively.

articleTitle: Analysis of Environmental Protection and Economic Sustainability by Integrating Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Technology (CSAT)
abstract: This paper investigates the interplay between environmental protection and sustainable economic growth using machine learning algorithms to analyze the correlation between PM2.5 levels and carbon emissions. It draws upon key theoretical models such as the “triple bottom line,” the “circular economy,” and the OECD's “green growth” theory, which advocate for a balance between environmental sustainability and economic growth. Empirical analysis focuses on the negative correlation between PM2.5 and subsequent per capita carbon emissions, suggesting that better air quality today may lead to higher carbon emissions tomorrow due to reduced environmental pressures and a subsequent focus on economic development. Additionally, good air quality may lower public urgency on environmental issues, potentially leading to higher carbon lifestyles and increased economic activities that contribute to carbon emissions. The study's findings underscore the complexity of environmental-economic dynamics, highlighting the need for multifaceted policy approaches that consider various factors including policy responses, public perception, and regional interactions. The research contributes a nuanced perspective to policymakers and scholars, emphasizing the intricate relationship between environmental governance and economic sustainability.

articleTitle: Novel Hybrid Neural Network Modeling Method for Melt Index Industrial Soft Sensor
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Technology (CSAT)
abstract: Polypropylene (PP) is a synthetic resin widely used in various industries and daily activities due to its exceptional physical characteristics. Therefore, improving the quality control of PP products is crucial for enterprises, and the Melt Index (MI) is a vital metric for assessing PP quality. To enable prompt and accurate MI prediction, we propose a pioneering hybrid neural network model. This model incorporates three components: the Causal Convolutional Neural Network (CCNN), Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM), and Temporal Pattern Attention (TPA). CCNN is employed to extract features from time series data, LSTM is used to identify temporal correlations and patterns, and TPA is used to extract implicit temporal pattern information across multiple time intervals. By employing this model in the actual polypropylene production process and comparing it with other different models, it achieves unparalleled performance in realtime MI computation.

articleTitle: Topsis-Based Group Decision-Making Methodology in Pythagorean Fuzzy Setting
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Technology (CSAT)
abstract: This paper studies the aggregation operator of pythagorean fuzzy set. And develop a new methodology for GDM problems in the pythagorean fuzzy environment.

articleTitle: Design of end-to-end Encryption Systems in the Digital Era
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Technology (CSAT)
abstract: On the Internet, data transmission is the most basic service, and many institutions use data transmission that contains confidential or sensitive information. Due to the insecurity of the network itself, it is prone to eavesdropping, malicious tampering, and malicious attacks. How to ensure the security of information has become a key issue in communication security. This article aimed to address the above issues and explore the design and application of end-to-end encryption systems in the digital era. This article first provided a detailed explanation of encryption technologies related to key management technology, then discussed how to build an end-to-end encryption system, and finally conducts an experimental analysis of end-to-end voice encryption. When it came to data latency, the delay time for encrypting and decrypting data in this scheme was 5.lms and 4.13ms, which was the smallest, indicating that the system data transmission in this scheme was the smoothest.

articleTitle: An Effective Knowledge Mining Method for Compressor Fault Text Data Based on Large Language Model
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Technology (CSAT)
abstract: The fault diagnosis method of compressors determines the reliability of the gas transmission pipeline station. Existing compressor fault diagnosis methods mostly relies on data-driven, which leads to a high application threshold from the mechanism. To address this issue, this paper introduces the knowledge graph into the compressor fault diagnosis for the first time and proposes a compressor fault text data knowledge mining method based on large language model. Firstly, the characteristics and principles of compressor faults are analyzed. Then, a text data knowledge mining model called CFRTE for compressors is constructed. Experimental results show that the Fl score of the CFRTE model can reach 0.98, meeting the requirements of compressor fault knowledge mining. Finally, combined with the results of knowledge mining and the graph database, a new system for the storage and indexing of the compressor fault knowledge graph is proposed. To further verify the role of the large language model in compressor fault knowledge mining, this paper conducts a comparative experiment of CFRTE models based on RNN encoder and BERT encoder. Experimental results show that compared with GRU, BiGRU, LSTM, and BiLSTM as the encoder layer, the Fl score of the CFRTE model with BERT as the encoder layer has increased by 26.78%, 6.18%, 21.89%, and 5.49% respectively. This work provides a systematic feasible scheme for introducing knowledge graphs into compressor fault diagnosis, which can be used for reference in the fault diagnosis of related equipment.

articleTitle: A Cloud Platform for Data of Three-Product Rapid Detection in the Development of Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Technology (CSAT)
abstract: Following customized and simplified concepts, a data cloud platform was designed which serves rapid detection of food, medicine, and cosmetics. At present, cloud computing is no longer just a type of distributed computing, but a new idea that is constantly evolving and improving through a combination of various computer technique. Under the wave of cloud computing, the developed data cloud platform is committed to transforming suspicious samples into the conclusions required by users in a one-stop way. Informing them by authorized terminals through 5G networks, it systematically connects a complete application chain with rapid detection equipment. The data cloud platform employs webpages as a carrier, which can facilitate the usage of mobile terminals for access and subsequent visualization operations.

articleTitle: Harmonizing Dynamic Frequency Analysis with Attention Mechanisms for Efficient Facial Image Authenticity Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Technology (CSAT)
abstract: Deepfake detection is increasingly critical in security and digital forensics. Our research presents a novel method that synergizes dynamic frequency domain analysis with attention mechanisms to discern Deepfakes more effectively. This approach is developed in response to the inadequacies of existing techniques when confronted with sophisticated image alterations. By leveraging frequency domain subtleties and an advanced attention mechanism, our model achieves heightened accuracy in identifying key facial anomalies. Our experimental results show that DFAM could yield 93.94% accuracy rate which is the best compared with state-of-the-arts on Deepfakes dataset.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Electrocardiogram Signal Analysis and Processing System Based on Cortex M4
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Technology (CSAT)
abstract: Sports require heart rate levels of different intensities, and electrocardiogram signals can provide important information about heart rate. By analyzing electrocardiogram signals, information about heart function and exercise performance can be obtained, helping athletes understand their exercise intensity and cardiovascular status. You can use For optimizing training plans and individualized sports training programs. For example, by monitoring electrocardiogram signals, the appropriate intensity and duration of exercise can be determined to achieve optimal training results. Electrocardiograms play a key role in the treatment of heart disease. In view of the problems of traditional ECG acquisition equipment such as being large, bulky, expensive, and unportable, a small automatic ECG signal analysis and processing system based on Cortex M4 was designed. The system is mainly composed of pulse sensor, ADC analog-to-digital conversion module, LCD liquid crystal display module, reset module, LED module and power module. First, the human body's bioelectrical signal passes through the pulse sensor and then is converted into a digital signal by the ADC. Secondly, the drawing function in the LCD liquid crystal display module is called to depict the ECG waveform, and then the adaptive threshold algorithm is used to calculate the heart rate value BPM and Display it; finally, the data obtained from the analog-to-digital conversion is printed through the serial debugger, and then MATLAB is used to further analyze and process the above data. The system is small and portable, with strong realtime operability and can accurately measure the human heart rate anytime and anywhere.

articleTitle: Optimisation Simulation of The Dynamics of The Waste Compactor Loading Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Technology (CSAT)
abstract: A brief introduction to the structure and working principle of the waste compactor loading mechanism, a three-dimensional structural model of the refuse loading mechanism was built using the mechanical drawing simulation software SOILDWORKS and a dynamic optimisation analysis of the mechanism was carried out, obtain the motion law of the main moving parts and the motion curve of each articulation point of the rubbish compactor loading mechanism, provides important parameters for the structural optimisation of the design of the loading mechanism. Use of kinetic analysis software, structural optimisation design calculations for tipping buckets, the total mass of the tipping bucket is significantly reduced.

articleTitle: Static Calibration Structure Design of 6D Force Sensor
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Technology (CSAT)
abstract: In recent years, with the rapid development of China's aerospace, automobile industry, robot application and other industries, 6D force sensor with its unique advantages, widely used in these fields. However, due to the high precision and difficult research, the 6D force sensor is subj ect to many constraints in the design and calibration. This paper first introduces the characteristics and application fields of 6D force sensor, but there is not a static calibration platform for 6D micro force / moment sensor. In order to meet the static calibration requirements of 6D micro force / torque sensor, a 6D micro force / torque sensor is designed and a prototype is made and the structural design is given.

articleTitle: Individualized Resource Allocation for 5G Network Slicing Based on Knapsack Stragegy
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Technology (CSAT)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of low network resource utilisation and resource wastage in 5G network slicing, a resource allocation algorithm for network slicing based on Knapsack Strategy (KS) is proposed. Considering the interests of Service Provider (SP) and network slicing tenants, as well as the personalised resource requirements of tenant slices, a personalised resource allocation model is established. The optimisation problem of network slicing resource allocation based on Knapsack strategy is to optimally allocate between limited network resources and random network slicing requests to maximise the utility and revenue of network slicing. Experimental results validate the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm. Compared with the traditional static state allocation and other fixed resource allocation methods, the algorithm shows significant improvement in both resource utilisation and resource wastage.

articleTitle: Application of Data Mining Technology in Computer Network Virus Prevention
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Technology (CSAT)
abstract: With the continuous advancement of Internet technology, computer network viruses have become a ubiquitous threat and have a certain impact on people's daily lives. Therefore, research on how to effectively prevent and control computer network security attacks has become very important. This article aims to analyze the existing practical application experience of domestic and foreign scholars, explore the application of data mining technology(DMT) in the field of computer network security, and perform a performance test on the computer network virus prevention model. The test results show that the computer network virus interception rate is above 93%, the data throughput is 6783k-9347k, and the virus processing time is 11s-17s. This article puts forward a perspective on data mining and its utilization strategies to achieve the goals of better maintaining system stability and reducing economic losses, discusses methods of information classification and feature extraction, and introduces their applications in other fields and their future prospects. In the current environment, it is of great significance to apply DMT to the field of computer network security, because it can mine valuable information from massive network data, help understand the nature of network security issues, and provide support for data-based decision-making.

articleTitle: Operation Management of Manned Space Station Base on Space-Integrated-Ground Network
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Technology (CSAT)
abstract: China manned space engineering has made many breakthroughs in manned space area and successfully completed the construction of China space station. During the operation of the space station in orbit, tasks such as rendezvous and docking, astronaut extravehicular activity, cargo extravehicular deployment and recovery, astronaut living and work, and scientific experiments are executed. In this paper, the requirements of management of China space station, the design of the space-integrated-ground network, and the execution of the space mission based on space-ground cooperation are described.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of YOLOv5 and YOLOv8 for Tear Film Lipid Layer Detection: Architectural Disparities, Performance Metrics, and Future Implications
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Technology (CSAT)
abstract: This study employs the YOLOv5 and hypothetical YOLOv8 algorithms to analyze 52 real-world ocular surface videos for tear film lipid layer detection. A comprehensive evaluation of architectural disparities, merits, and demerits is conducted, emphasizing critical measurement parameters, including mean Average Precision (mAP), Specificity, recall, fl-score, and Frame Per Second (FPS). The assessments take place on a PC featuring an Intel Core i5-10500H CPU, with an input size of 640*640 pixels. Results indicate significant performance distinctions, with YOLOv8 demonstrating superior accuracy at a potential cost to computational efficiency. A proposed future research direction explores dry eye detection based on liquid detection using natural images and videos captured by mobile phones, aiming to leverage widespread accessibility for enhanced diagnostics in real-world settings.

articleTitle: Load Aggregators based on Improved Particle Swarm Optimization Algorithm Participate in the Research of Multi-market Operation Optimization Model
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Technology (CSAT)
abstract: Through the participation of load aggregators in the market, the load characteristics of grid operation and user satisfaction can be significantly improved. In this paper, the operating framework of multi-agent load aggregator is designed and its characteristics are analyzed. Secondly, driven by the market price, there is a game relationship between the dispatching center and various entities of the load aggregator. Using game theory technology, with the dispatching center as the leader and load aggregators such as electric vehicles, air conditioning units and energy storage units as followers, the operation optimization model of load aggregator participation in the market is established. The optimization method of improved particle swarm optimization algorithm is put forward to analyze the model, and the ultimate goal of each load aggregator is realized.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Impact of Distributed Photovoltaic on the Operating Parameters of Rural Distribution Station Area
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Technology (CSAT)
abstract: With the completion of a large number of “photovoltaic poverty alleviation” projects,Distributed photovoltaic connected to the grid has a huge impact on the power flow and distribution network voltage in the distribution substation area,the safety and stability of system lines are facing challenges. This paper analyzes the current development status of distributed photovoltaic in rural China,Jinzhai County in China is selected to study and analyze the operation of its distributed PV, The impact of load penetration rate on line losses, power quality, and security of power supply in the operation of rural distribution substations is sorted out. The current common optimization measures for distributed PV access are discussed, and measures to solve the actual PV operation problems in the distribution station area are summarized and proposed.

articleTitle: Method for Capturing Tennis Training Actions under Machine Vision Images
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Technology (CSAT)
abstract: In recent years, tennis has gradually emerged, attracting a large number of participants, and computer technology has also been widely applied in this field. However, there are still some shortcomings in the professional training of tennis in motion capture. This article proposes a tennis training motion capture method based on machine vision images (MVI), which utilizes MVI technology to collect and capture tennis training movements. The collected tennis training motion images are used for motion object detection, motion feature collection and extraction, motion feature analysis and tracking. This article uses machine vision deep learning algorithms, combined with OpenPose pose estimation algorithm and YOLO algorithm, to reconstruct, segment, extract, and classify image features that capture actions. This article utilizes MVI enhancement technology to improve the resolution and adaptability of tennis training motion capture. The experiment shows that the method proposed in this article achieves optimization of tennis training motion capture, improving the accuracy and reliability of tennis training motion in MVI capture technology.

articleTitle: Path Planning for UAV Based on MPSO
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Technology (CSAT)
abstract: Focusing on the path planning problem of unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) in three-dimensional space, a path planning method based on modified particle swarm optimization (MPSO) algorithm based path planning method for UAV was proposed. Firstly, a path planning solution model was established, which took the path length as the objective function and the UAV's own performance constraints and space obstacle threats as constraints. Secondly, on the basis of this model, an improved particle swarm optimization algorithm with dynamically adjusted inertia weight was used to plan the UAV's navigation path. The global search ability and the local search ability of the algorithm are relatively balanced in the search process. While ensuring the search speed, the probability of the algorithm converging to the global optimal solution is increased, and the efficiency and reliability of path planning are improved. Finally, the simulation results showed that the improved particle swarm optimization algorithm was effective in solving the path planning problem of UAV.

Index Terms: Speed Of The Unmanned Aerial Vehicles

articleTitle: Design and Research of Personalized News Recommendation System Based on LSTM Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Technology (CSAT)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of low extraction accuracy caused by the lack of consideration of the impact of the following text of the central word on the topic word in LSTM network, the author proposes a personalized news recommendation system based on LSTM algorithm. Firstly, the LSTM algorithm is used to model the preceding and following information of the central word in two directions; Then, attention mechanism is introduced into the bidirectional LSTM algorithm to assign higher weights to features with higher influence; Finally, use the softmax layer to classify the words in the document into topic words or non topic words. And a two-stage model training method was also proposed, which is to pre train the model on the automatically annotated training set and then use the manually annotated dataset to train the model. The experiment conducted topic word extraction tasks on three types of news texts: sports, entertainment, and technology. The experimental results indicate that: The Att-iBi LSTM algorithm proposed by the author has improved F1 values by 13.78%, 24.31%, and 3.32% compared to SVM, TextRank, and LSTM, respectively. The Att-iBi LSTM algorithm trained in two stages has increased F1 values by 1.55% compared to the first stage training method. Conclusion: The system has achieved good extraction results in news topic word extraction tasks in different fields, indicating the generalization of this method.

articleTitle: Applications of Blockchain and IoT in Sustainability Information Disclosure
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Technology (CSAT)
abstract: Sustainable development and information disclosure have recently garnered significant attention in the light of pressing environmental and social concerns, such as the climate crisis and labor rights issues. Concurrently, the emergence of cutting-edge technologies such as blockchain and the Internet of Things (IoT) has sparked optimism for enhancing and streamlining the disclosure of information related to sustainable development. This paper is centered on two key aspects. Initially, it scrutinizes the fundamental framework of sustainable development information disclosure, followed by an exploration of the revolutionary impact brought about by the integration of two emerging technologies: blockchain and IoT. The study not only illuminates the influence of sustainability on corporate disclosure, but it also anticipates the potential contributions that future technologies could make in facilitating this transformative process. Sustainable development information disclosure remains a challenge due to the diversity of stakeholders, varying information requirements, and a lack of standard harmonization. Technology is poised to play an important role in addressing these challenges.

articleTitle: Research on the Power Management System of Automatic Waste Smoke Recycling Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Technology (CSAT)
abstract: The automatic waste smoke recycling vehicle has electrical equipment such as an onboard weighing system and a radio transceiver system. Adequate and stable power supply is an important factor in achieving the functionality of electrical equipment during its use. In production practice, the situation where electrical equipment cannot work properly due to insufficient electrical energy may bring inconvenience to workshop production. In order to improve electrical energy reserves, the capacity of the battery is often increased, and the volume and weight of the battery will also significantly increase, resulting in a significant increase in the load of waste smoke trucks. How to balance the volume, weight, and functional implementation of electrical equipment is also the problem addressed in this paper.

articleTitle: Application of Computer Technology in the Metaverse Exhibition Country Partner (CP) and Operation Partner (OP) Modules
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Technology (CSAT)
abstract: This paper delves into the application of computer technology in the metaverse exhibition modules of Country Partner (CP) and Operation Partner (OP). It begins by noting the proactive response of Chinese educational institutions to the educational and research trends of the metaverse, highlighting the critical role of VRI AR, 5G networks, and the Internet of Things in constructing metaverse experiences. The paper thoroughly analyzes aspects such as design modeling of metaverse scenarios, aesthetic visual effects of scenes, digital twin design, and augmented reality technology, emphasizing the importance of interdisciplinary collaboration. In the CP aspect, it focuses on the application of metaverse spatial scenario design and human-computer interaction technologies, including the use of tools such as 3DMAX, Sketchup, and Unity. Regarding the OP aspect, it explores the application of computer technology by various positions in metaverse exhibitions, underscoring the potential applications of metaverse technology in fields like tourism management, exhibition specialties, and e-commerce. The paper concludes with suggestions for optimizing the application and innovative education of computer technology in Chinese universities, promoting the integration and development of new engineering and new liberal arts disciplines in the direction of the metaverse.

articleTitle: Research and Design of an Intelligent Academic Affairs Assessment System Based on ASP.NET
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Technology (CSAT)
abstract: In order to fully reflect the work characteristics and special functions of vocational school teachers in practical situations, the author proposes an intelligent learning management system based on ASP.NET has already been planned. Taking teacher performance evaluation as an example, combined with the current development status of higher vocational colleges, the author carefully studied the performance evaluation of teachers in higher vocational colleges, and designed a research and performance evaluation system specifically applied to personnel management in higher vocational colleges using voice measurement system. NET technology, C language, and SQL database management system were used. The platform system includes data management, analysis and evaluation, and scoring systems. The results showed that Load Runner also simulated user interrupt performance, and the implementation status of system performance testing met the requirements, with a login time of 1 second. Conclusion: Establishing this system has an overall content oriented role in its development process. When designing the system, this process is consistent with the software development process, which utilizes various software development theories.

articleTitle: Design of Physical Health Monitoring System Based on Wearable Devices
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Technology (CSAT)
abstract: In response to the low accuracy of existing physical health monitoring systems in measuring human energy consumption, which affects their monitoring efficiency, the author proposes a wearable device based college student physical health monitoring system. By using wearable devices to obtain acceleration information and physiological indicators of college students during exercise, and using them as independent variable data, a college student activity energy consumption detection model is constructed to achieve the goal of physical health monitoring. The experimental results show that in energy consumption detection for males and females, the RMSE values of this model are 0.11 ± 0.02 and 0.121 ± 0.03; Compared to the daily activity detection model, this model has higher detection accuracy and better detection performance. Conclusion: Applying this model to the monitoring system can achieve accurate monitoring of the physical health of college students, meeting the system design requirements.

articleTitle: An Intelligent Recommendation System for Improvisation Playing and Singing Built with Database Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Technology (CSAT)
abstract: In order to facilitate the retrieval of relevant information and provide users with an efficient method, the author uses database technology to propose an intelligent recommendation system for improvisation and singing. This algorithm supplements traditional search methods to a certain extent. Based on this study, a thorough analysis of the recommended methods was conducted through collaboration, and their specifications were carefully examined. Finally, a systematic software analysis of the model was conducted using B/S software, achieving personalized music recommendation. The results indicate that in order to provide song recommendations to the target user Xiao Ming, the system first calculates the similarity between Xiao Ming and other users in the database. Subsequently, the system selects the K users with the highest similarity score and retrieves their improvised playback time. Based on the investigation, the system hypothesized Xiaoming's preference for classical improvisation. Then calculate the similarity score for the last three users, namely Zhang San, Li Si, and Wang Wu. Finally, through frequent mining and evaluation of project set association rules, the system recommended the following songs to Xiao Ming: Nocturne, Scottish Dance, and Narrative Music. Conclusion: The system aims to provide a comprehensive set of services that effectively meet the recommendation needs of users. With this system, users can receive recommendations for various improvisation and singing styles, which can be customized according to each user's personal preferences.

articleTitle: Web Crawlers for News Aggregation Systems based on Graph Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Technology (CSAT)
abstract: The author delves into the news aggregation system web crawler KMGCN based on graph convolutional neural networks. KMGCN effectively improves the efficiency and accuracy of news aggregation by constructing multimodal content graphs and utilizing knowledge driven graph convolutional networks. This study evaluated the performance of KMGCN on different datasets and validated its superiority by comparing it with benchmark methods. This study explores the performance of a news aggregation system web crawler based on graph convolutional neural networks when the feature dimension changes. By adjusting the feature dimension d, it was observed that the accuracy of KMGCN slightly improved when d increased from 50 to 250 on both datasets. However, as d further increased to 300, the accuracy on one of the datasets slightly decreased. For the F1 indicator, increasing d to 200 did not bring any improvement. After comprehensive analysis, determine that the word vector dimension d in the text is 100 to optimize the performance of KMGCN. Overall, the experimental results of this study demonstrate the effectiveness of the method on two common datasets. KMGCN has significant advantages in handling multimodal content, filtering noise, and outliers, providing new ideas and methods for the development of news aggregation.

articleTitle: Research on the Influence of Color Feature Extraction Methods on Painting Styles Classification
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Technology (CSAT)
abstract: The collection and classification of paintings and artworks digitally has become a critical component of heritage conservation. In different styles and genres of painting, painting techniques and color schemes differ significantly. The existing image classification methods utilize features such as color, outline, and texture to identify paintings, with color being the most prominent. There are a number of specialized extraction calculation methods available in the literature. During the course of this study, an experiment is conducted to compare the effectiveness of existing algorithms for extracting color features from paintings in order to classify them according to their style. This objective is achieved by categorizing and summarizing them. The effects of color space selection, color-position relationship, color and non-color feature combination, and color complexity on classification results are examined based on the minimum closure ellipsoid algorithm. As a result of comparing several sets of experiments, it was found that feature extraction methods that remained true to color-position relationships significantly improved classification results, whereas combining more non-color features or increasing the complexity of color features did not significantly improve classification accuracy. As a result of this study, it is clear that color image-based classification tasks should be focused on discovering color correlations and positional relationships.

articleTitle: On Network Communication and National Information Security
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Technology (CSAT)
abstract: Protecting network information security, as the most critical prerequisite of network publishing, is the essential content and crucial factor of state information security and the foundation of social security. With the virtual community becoming more influential, the country's political, economic, and cultural sovereignty, technology, and military security increasingly rely on effectively managing “the Fourth Territory” (cyberspace). In light that network publishing could endanger state information security, the network security defense system for information must be built from the following aspects: mastering the advanced technology of information security, increasing the core competitiveness of information security management, strengthening internet surveillance, and emergence response capability; improving the legislation and standard of information security and raise the bar of information management; and quickening the development of internet talents and raise the public awareness of information security. Hence, national information security can be protected to safeguard national information sovereignty and promote a harmonious society.

articleTitle: The Prospect of Metaverse and Digital Ecology Security Guarantee
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Technology (CSAT)
abstract: The Metaverse is an immersive interconnected space that integrates the digital and physical worlds. It is a future industry where the new generation of information technology integrates innovation and application, and it is an advanced form of integration of the digital economy and the real economy. The Metaverse means that many users' lives, work, leisure, and social interactions will increasingly be completed in virtual reality. On the one hand, the Metaverse promotes social development, but on the other hand, there are dangers and ethical and moral challenges that cannot be ignored. Therefore, it is vital to improve the technical safety standards of the Metaverse and safeguard national sovereignty, information security, cultural security, industrial security, and other fields. Strengthen the construction of the Metaverse legal system, improve the public's digital ethics and moral literacy, cultivate the ecological environment of the Metaverse by promoting advantages and eliminating disadvantages, guide the healthy, safe, and high-quality development of the Metaverse industry, support the construction of a manufacturing power, a network power, and a cultural power, and promote the all-round development of humanity and social material development. The construction of civilization and spiritual civilization is precisely the direction of efforts in constructing the metaverse in the new era.

articleTitle: Research on Handwriting Character Recognition Technology Based on Bidirectional Long Short Term Memory Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Technology (CSAT)
abstract: Handwritten character recognition has always been a research hotspot in the fields of computer vision and pattern recognition. In recent years, significant progress has been made in this area with the rapid development of deep learning technology, particularly in handwritten character recognition based on neural networks. This paper proposes an improved Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory Neural Network (BiLSTM) for handwritten character recognition. Firstly, we perform preprocessing, such as normalization, based on the dataset's characteristics. Then, a CNN network is used to extract features from the images. Next, we employ a Bidirectional LSTM network to remember the word-level relationships of the handwritten text sequences and make predictions. Finally, we use the CTC-Loss as the loss function, which enables the training set with full sentence annotations to converge under the aforementioned network. During the training process, the backpropagation algorithm is utilized to optimize the network parameters. Experimental results demonstrate that our proposed BiLSTM-based handwritten character recognition technique achieves the best recognition performance when compared with multiple network models. Our approach exhibits significant improvements in both accuracy and robustness compared to traditional methods.

articleTitle: Design of an English Speaking Interactive System Based on Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Technology (CSAT)
abstract: In order to improve the human-machine interaction effect of current English service robots, the author proposes an English intelligent dialogue human-machine interaction system using speech recognition as the basic method. By optimizing the feature parameter extraction method and speech recognition model of the interaction system, combined with corresponding module design, the performance of the interaction system has been improved to a certain extent. The simulation results show that compared with other feature parameter extraction algorithms, the LPMFCC feature parameter extraction algorithm in this study has a higher recognition rate of 87.4%; Compared with the pre improved HMM model, the improved HMM model proposed by the author can complete training faster and with lower training errors, requiring only 4 training sessions to complete the training. Conclusion: The results indicate that the English intelligent dialogue human-machine interaction system proposed by the author can achieve good performance and achieve good human-machine interaction effects, which has certain reference value for practical design.

articleTitle: A Comparative Analysis of Image-Based Classification and Object Detection for the Ocular Redness Grading
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Technology (CSAT)
abstract: This study presents a comprehensive exploration into ocular red-eye grading, employing ResNet-based image classification and YOLOv8-based object detection methodologies. The comparative analysis reveals distinct strengths and weaknesses inherent in each approach. While ResNet exhibits commendable accuracy and Specificity, its susceptibility to potential overfitting suggests suitability for tasks requiring detailed feature analysis. Conversely, YOLOv8 demonstrates superior performance across accuracy, Specificity, recall, and Fl-score metrics, positioning it as a promising solution for efficient ocular red-eye grading, particularly in real-time processing scenarios. Acknowledging study limitations, including potential dataset biases and challenges associated with diverse ocular conditions, is imperative for ensuring robustness and generalizability. Future research directions emphasize refining models, incorporating additional metrics, and diversifying datasets. Consideration of AI-based methodologies from natural images and videos, such as those captured by smartphones, is suggested for further investigation. Collaborative efforts between computer vision researchers and healthcare professionals hold promise for enhancing clinical relevance. The adaptability of ResN et and YOLOv8 underscores their potential utility in clinical settings, signaling advancements in diagnostic tools and personalized patient care within ophthalmology.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Agricultural Information Management System Based on Mobile GIS
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Technology (CSAT)
abstract: With the rapid development of mobile networks, people have put forward higher-level requirements for agricultural information management systems to meet the needs of users and improve the level of agricultural product management. To this end, this study is committed to developing an agricultural information system that is scalable and easy to operate based on GIS (Geographical Information System) technology, information technology, and database applications. This article also tests the performance of the system. The test results show that the security of authentication is between 95% and 99%, the security of access control is between 93% and 97%, and the security of access control is between 93% and 97%, and the security of data encryption is between 92% and 98%. The compatibility of the system on different devices is 73%-82%, the compatibility of different browsers is 81%-89%, and the compatibility of different operating systems is 72%-79%. The system's CPU usage is 1%-5%, memory usage is 1%-6%, and hard disk usage is 2%-6%. In view of the excellent performance of this system, it should be applied in agricultural production practices to further improve management efficiency and economic benefits.

articleTitle: Design of Mathematics Learning System Based on Mobile Terminal and Internet Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Technology (CSAT)
abstract: In order to effectively integrate and supplement the traditional mathematics after-school tutoring model with information technology, the author proposes a mathematics after-school tutoring system based on mobile terminals and internet technology. A teaching live streaming system was designed and implemented based on a mobile platform, which mainly includes two modules: a mathematical whiteboard (including geometric drawing, algebraic operations, and electronic whiteboard) and a video live streaming (audio acquisition, video acquisition, network transmission, and video playback). The results show that the amount of information transmitted by the server per second and the load capacity of server client interaction can withstand high loads with 200 users logging in simultaneously, and the system client and server can run smoothly under high loads. Conclusion: The good interaction effect between the client has been demonstrated on both the simulator and the real machine, and testing has shown that the system can operate normally and has good real-time video synchronization transmission capability.
